docs.title: Nyx
docs.text: Nyx is a nodal execution graph written in Python. You build a stage out of nodes whose components are connected by links, and run it in a PySide6 editor or headless from the command line. Plugins add nodes, components and datatypes. A TCP bridge lets a stage run code in other applications such as Maya and Blender.

docs.title: Guides
docs.text:
• User Guide

    How a graph executes, datatypes, referencing other stages, remote nodes, batch mode and the configuration file.

  • Developer Guide

    How the registry works, profiling, and how to write plugins: nodes, function nodes, components, QML editors, datatypes, util objects and graphics objects.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/sowwic/nyx.git
cd nyx
uv sync --locked --dev
uv run nyx                                   # open the editor
uv run nyx stage run path/to/stage.nyx       # run a stage headless

See the README for installation as a package, the standalone build, plugins and the bridge.

def __init__(self, initialize_plugins=True) -> None:
    """Initialize NyxApplication.

    Args:
        initialize_plugins (bool): load registered plugins on startup.
    """
    super().__init__(sys.argv)
    self._session = NyxSession()
    self._plugin_manager = NyxPluginManager()
    self.aboutToQuit.connect(self._session.shutdown)
    self.setApplicationDisplayName("Nyx")
    self.setWindowIcon(self._create_application_icon())
    self.setApplicationVersion(__version__)
    LOGGER.setLevel(self.config.values.logging_level)

    self.register_builtin_content()
    self.pre_initialize()
    if initialize_plugins:
        self._plugin_manager.initialize_plugins()
    self.post_initialize()

def post_initialize(self) -> None:
    """Create the QML engine and main window, then close the startup splash."""
    try:
        self._load_resources()
        register_default_actions()
        self._setup_qml_engine()

        NyxEditorMainWindow.display()
        if self.config.values.editor_behaviour.new_stage_on_launch:
            self.main_window().on_stage_new()
    finally:
        if self._startup_splash:
            self._startup_splash.finish(self.main_window())
            self._startup_splash = None

def sync_qml_import_paths(self):
    """Add any registry import roots the engine doesn't know about yet."""
    already_known_import_paths = set(self._qml_engine.importPathList())
    for import_root_directory in NYX_REGISTRY.qml_import_root_directories:
        import_root_path_text = str(import_root_directory)
        if import_root_path_text not in already_known_import_paths:
            self._qml_engine.addImportPath(import_root_path_text)

def add_run_arguments(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    """Add the arguments of running a stage.

    Args:
        parser (argparse.ArgumentParser): parser to add them to.
    """
    parser.add_argument("path", type=pathlib.Path, help="stage file to run")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--no-bridge",
        dest="bridge",
        action="store_false",
        help="do not start the bridge server, so remote nodes have no client to use",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--port",
        type=int,
        help="port of the bridge server for this run, instead of the configured one",

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Create the parser of the `nyx` command.

    Returns:
        argparse.ArgumentParser: parser. Without a command the editor is opened.
    """
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="nyx", description="Nyx, a Python nodal execution graph."
    )
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", metavar="command")
    stage = commands.add_parser("stage", help="work with stage files")
    stage_commands = stage.add_subparsers(
        dest="stage_command", metavar="command", required=True
    )
    run = stage_commands.add_parser("run", help="run a stage without the editor")
    add_run_arguments(run)
    return parser

def run_stage(
    path: pathlib.Path | str,
    bridge: bool = True,
    port: int | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Run a stage file without the editor.

    The application config is used but never saved.

    Args:
        path (pathlib.Path | str): stage file.
        bridge (bool): start the bridge server, if the config enables it.
        port (int | None): port of the bridge server, the configured one if omitted.

    Returns:
        int: exit code, 0 when the stage ran, 1 when it failed, 2 when it could not
            be loaded.
    """
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from nyx.core.logger import NyxLogger

    # Before the other modules make their loggers, like the editor does: the nyx loggers
    # write to the console and the log file.
    logging.setLoggerClass(NyxLogger)
    from PySide6 import QtWidgets

    from nyx.api.v1 import Stage
    from nyx.application import NyxApplication

    app = QtWidgets.QApplication.instance() or NyxApplication()
    session = app.session
    try:
        path = pathlib.Path(path)
        if not path.is_file():
            logging.getLogger(__name__).error("Stage file not found: %s", path)
            return EXIT_USAGE

        stage = Stage()  # nodes do not keep their stage alive
        if stage.import_json(path) is None:
            logging.getLogger(__name__).error("Could not load the stage from %s", path)
            return EXIT_USAGE

        if bridge:
            if port is not None:
                session.config.values.bridge.port = port
            session.autostart_bridge_server()

        return _crawl(stage)
    finally:
        session.shutdown()

def accepts(self, other: Datatype) -> bool:
    """Check whether a value of another datatype can be given to this one.

    Args:
        other (Datatype): datatype of the provided value.

    Returns:
        bool: datatypes are compatible.
    """
    if self.type_id == other.type_id or other.type_id in self.compatible_with:
        return True
    if self.ignores_wildcards or other.ignores_wildcards:
        return False
    return self.is_wildcard or other.is_wildcard

def cast(self, value: typing.Any) -> typing.Any:
    """Convert a value to this datatype.

    Args:
        value (typing.Any): evaluated value.

    Raises:
        DatatypeCastError: the value can't be converted.

    Returns:
        typing.Any: converted value.
    """
    try:
        return self.caster(value)
    except Exception as err:
        raise DatatypeCastError(
            f"Can't cast {value!r} to {self.display_name}: {err}"
        ) from err

def matches(self, value: typing.Any) -> bool:

def __init__(
    self,
    stage: Stage,
    source: UUID | str,
    target: UUID | str,
    uuid: UUID | str | None = None,
):
    """Initialize Link.

    Args:
        stage (Stage): owning stage.
        source (UUID | str): source component uuid.
        target (UUID | str): target component uuid.
        uuid (UUID | str | None): link uuid. Generated if omitted.
    """
    self._stage = stage
    self.source = self.as_uuid(source)
    self.target = self.as_uuid(target)
    self._pins: list[QtCore.QPointF] = []
    super().__init__(uuid)

@classmethod
def deserialize(
    cls,
    stage: Stage,
    serialized_link: OrderedDict[str, typing.Any],
    link: Link | None = None,
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption = RestoreUuidOption.ATTEMPT_RESTORE,
):
    """Create or update a link from serialized data.

    Args:
        stage (Stage): target stage.
        serialized_link (OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]): serialized link.
        link (Link | None): existing link to update. A new one is created if omitted.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how the serialized uuid is restored.

    Returns:
        Link: deserialized link.
    """
    new_uuid = cls.choose_new_uuid(
        stage=stage,
        serialized_data=serialized_link,
        restore_option=restore_uuid,
    )
    if not link:
        link = cls(
            stage=stage,
            source=serialized_link[cls.SOURCE_UUID_KEY],
            target=serialized_link[cls.TARGET_UUID_KEY],
            uuid=new_uuid,
        )
    else:
        link.uuid = new_uuid

    link._pins = [
        QtCore.QPointF(x, y) for x, y in serialized_link.get(cls.PINS_KEY, ())
    ]
    return link

@classmethod
def is_registered(cls, stage: Stage, link: LinkLike) -> bool:
    """Is the link valid and known by both of its components.

    Args:
        stage (Stage): stage to search.
        link (LinkLike): link, uuid or path.

    Returns:
        bool: link is registered on both components.
    """
    try:
        link: Link = stage.get_object(link)
    except StageObjectQueryError:
        return False

    if not link.is_valid:
        return False

    present_in_source = link.uuid in link.source_component.links_uuids
    present_in_target = link.uuid in link.target_component.links_uuids

    return all([present_in_source, present_in_target])

def serialize(self) -> OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]:
    """Serialize the link, including the relative path between its ends.

    Returns:
        OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]: serialized data.
    """
    serialized_data = super().serialize()
    serialized_data[self.META_DATA_KEY].update(
        {
            "relative_path": StagePathResolver.compute_relative_path(
                source_path=self.source_path, destination_path=self.target_path
            ).as_posix()
        }
    )
    serialized_data[self.SOURCE_UUID_KEY] = str(self.source)
    serialized_data[self.TARGET_UUID_KEY] = str(self.target)
    if self._pins:
        serialized_data[self.PINS_KEY] = [[pin.x(), pin.y()] for pin in self._pins]
    return serialized_data

def __init__(
    self,
    name: str | None = None,
    uuid: UUID | str | None = None,
    parent: Node | None = None,
    display_name: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Initialize Node.

    Args:
        name (str | None): address name. Defaults to the node type's default name.
        uuid (UUID | str | None): node uuid. Generated if omitted.
        parent (Node | None): parent node.

            name of the node type.

    QtGui.QStandardItem.__init__(self, name or self.DEFAULT_NAME)

    self.setData(name or self.DEFAULT_NAME, role=self.Roles.NAME)
    self.setData(
        display_name or self.get_type_display_name(), role=self.Roles.DISPLAY_NAME
    )
    self._components_model = NodeComponentsModel(node=self)
    self._util_objects: dict[UUID, UtilObject] = {}
    self._subtitle_binding: _SubtitleBinding | None = None
    self._components_model.dataChanged.connect(self._on_components_data_changed)

    if parent:
        parent.appendRow(self)

def appendRow(self, items: Node | typing.Sequence[Node]) -> None:
    """Override Qt method.

    - Generates new unique name.
    - Set cached path to current.
    - Store path into stage path map.

    Args:
        items (typing.Sequence): items to append.

    Raises:
        ValueError: path exists in stage path map.

    """
    if not isinstance(items, typing.Sequence):
        items = [items]

    for node in items:
        unique_name = self.stage.generate_unique_node_name(
            node.name, parent_node=self
        )
        node.setData(unique_name, role=Node.Roles.NAME)
        self.stage.register_node(node)
        super().appendRow(node)
        node.refresh_label()
        node.setup()
        node.post_setup_hook()

@classmethod
def deserialize(
    cls,
    serialized_node: OrderedDict[str, typing.Any],
    node: Node | None = None,
    parent_node: Node | None = None,
    context: NodeDeserializationContext | None = None,
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption = RestoreUuidOption.ATTEMPT_RESTORE,
) -> Node:
    """Create or update a node and its contents from serialized data.

    Components, children and links are restored with the node.

    Args:
        serialized_node (OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]): serialized node.
        node (Node | None): existing node to update.
        parent_node (Node | None): parent of the created node.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext | None): deserialization context.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how serialized uuids are restored.

    Returns:
        Node: deserialized node.

    Raises:
        ValueError: if neither node nor parent_node is given.
    """
    if not (node or parent_node):
        raise ValueError(
            "Either parent node or node must be provided for deserialization."
        )

    stage = parent_node.stage if parent_node else node.stage
    uuid = cls.choose_new_uuid(
        stage=stage,
        serialized_data=serialized_node,
        restore_option=restore_uuid,
    )

    if not node:
        node_cls = NYX_REGISTRY.get_node_cls(serialized_node[cls.TYPE_ID_KEY])
        node = node_cls(
            name=serialized_node[cls.NAME_KEY],
            uuid=uuid,
            parent=parent_node,
            display_name=cls._read_display_name(serialized_node),
        )
    else:
        node.rename(serialized_node[cls.NAME_KEY])
        if not node.is_stage_root_node:  # the root is always called "stage"
            node.set_display_name(cls._read_display_name(serialized_node))

    context = context or NodeDeserializationContext(
        stage=stage,
        entry_node=node,
    )
    if context.entry_node is None:
        context.entry_node = node

    LOGGER.debug(f"Deserializing: {serialized_node.get(cls.NAME_KEY)}")
    if uuid is not None:
        node.uuid = uuid

    context.register(
        serialized_uuid=serialized_node[cls.UUID_KEY], new_uuid=node.uuid
    )
    links_data = serialized_node.get(cls.LINKS_KEY, [])

    # Roles that should exist for normal and reference nodes
    node.set_active(serialized_node.get(cls.ACTIVE_KEY, True))
    node.set_position(
        QtCore.QPointF(*serialized_node.get(cls.POSITION_KEY, [0.0, 0.0]))
    )
    node.execution_order = serialized_node.get(
        cls.EXECUTION_ORDER_KEY, cls.get_type_execution_order()
    )

    node.deserialize_contents(
        serialized_node, context=context, restore_uuid=restore_uuid
    )
    stage.register_node(node)

    # Links
    if context.defer_links:
        context.collect_links(links_data)
    elif context.entry_node is node:
        node.deserialize_links(
            links_data=links_data, restore_uuid=restore_uuid, context=context
        )

    # Everything this run creates exists now: let object paths find their targets.
    # With deferred links the caller owns the run and does it once all is created.
    if context.entry_node is node and not context.defer_links:
        context.run_deferred()

    return node

def deserialize_contents(
    self,
    serialized_node: OrderedDict[str, typing.Any],
    context: NodeDeserializationContext,
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption,
) -> None:
    """Create the children and components of the node from serialized data.

    Override in subclasses that get their contents from somewhere else.

    Args:
        serialized_node (OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]): serialized node.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext): deserialization context.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how serialized uuids are restored.
    """
    for child_data in serialized_node.get(self.CHILDREN_KEY, {}):
        self.deserialize(
            serialized_node=child_data,
            parent_node=self,
            restore_uuid=restore_uuid,
            context=context,
        )

    self.components_model.deserialize(
        serialized_node.get(self.COMPONENTS_KEY, []),
        context=context,
        restore_uuid=restore_uuid,
    )
    self.deserialize_util_objects(
        serialized_node.get(self.UTIL_OBJECTS_KEY, []),
        context=context,
        restore_uuid=restore_uuid,
    )

def deserialize_links(
    self,
    links_data: list[OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]],
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption,
    context: NodeDeserializationContext,
):
    """Create links from serialized data.

        links_data (list[OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]]): serialized links.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how serialized uuids are restored.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext): deserialization context.
    """
    for each_link_data in links_data:
        link_data = context.remap_link(each_link_data)
        if link_data is None:
            continue
        link = Link.deserialize(
            stage=self.stage,
            serialized_link=link_data,
            link=None,
            restore_uuid=restore_uuid,
        )
        self.stage.register_link(link)

def execution_hook(self):
    """Execute this node.

    Raises:
        err: run time exception raised during code execution.

    """
    self.reset_execution_status()
    if not self.is_active():
        return

    self.execution_status = NodeExecutionStatus.PENDING
    start_time = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        self.pre_execution_hook()
        self.evaluate_components()
        self.evaluate()
        self.execute_components()
        self.execute()
        self.post_execution_hook()
    except StageExecutionCancelled:
        self.execution_status = NodeExecutionStatus.NOT_RAN
        raise
    except Exception as err:
        LOGGER.exception(f"{self} | Execution error: {err}")
        self.raised_exception = err
        self.execution_status = NodeExecutionStatus.ERROR
        self.stage.execution_failed.emit(self)
        raise err
    else:
        self.execution_status = NodeExecutionStatus.SUCCESS

    total_time = time.perf_counter() - start_time
    LOGGER.info(f"Executed in {total_time:.4f}: {self.path}")

def list_parents(self, as_queue: bool = False) -> list[Node] | deque[Node]:
    """List parents recursively.

    Args:
        as_queue: If result should be returned as deque. Defaults to False.

    Returns:
        list[Node] | deque[Node]: parent nodes collection.

    """
    parents = deque()
    direct_parent: Node = self.parent()
    if direct_parent and not direct_parent.is_stage_root_node:
        parents.appendleft(self.parent())
        parents.extendleft(self.parent().list_parents())
    return parents if as_queue else list(parents)

def rename_display(self, display_name: str) -> None:
    """Rename the node: set the display name, and the address name follows.

    The address name is made from the display name, with a number added when a
    sibling has it already.

    Args:
        display_name (str): new display name.

    Raises:
        ValueError: the name has no letters or digits to make an address from.
    """
    display_name = display_name.strip()
    address_name = NameValidator.to_address_name(display_name)
    if not address_name:
        raise ValueError(f"Cannot make a node name out of {display_name!r}")
    self.rename(address_name)

def serialize(
    self, context: NodeSerializationContext | None = None
) -> OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]:
    """Serialize node to dict.

    Returns:
        OrderedDict: serialized data

    """
    context = context or NodeSerializationContext(stage=self.stage, entry_node=self)

    serialized_data = super().serialize()
    serialized_data[self.NAME_KEY] = self.name
    serialized_data[self.DISPLAY_NAME_KEY] = self.display_name
    serialized_data[self.TYPE_ID_KEY] = self.get_type_id()
    serialized_data[self.ACTIVE_KEY] = self.is_active()
    serialized_data[self.POSITION_KEY] = self.serializable_position()
    serialized_data[self.EXECUTION_ORDER_KEY] = self.execution_order
    serialized_data.update(self.serialize_contents(context))
    self.collect_serialized_links(context)

    if context.entry_node is self:
        serialized_data[Node.LINKS_KEY] = context.get_serialized_links()
    return serialized_data

def serialize_contents(
    self, context: NodeSerializationContext
) -> OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]:
    """Serialize what the node holds: its components and children.

    Override in subclasses that get their contents from somewhere else.

    Args:
        context (NodeSerializationContext): serialization context.

    Returns:
        OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]: data merged into the serialized node.
    """
    contents = OrderedDict(self.components_model.serialize())
    contents[self.CHILDREN_KEY] = [
        child_node.serialize(context=context) for child_node in self.list_children()
    ]
    contents[self.UTIL_OBJECTS_KEY] = [
        util_object.serialize() for util_object in self.util_objects
    ]
    return contents

@classmethod
def deserialize(
    cls,
    data: OrderedDict,
    node: Node,
    context: NodeDeserializationContext,
    component: NodeComponent | None = None,
    restore_uuid=RestoreUuidOption.ATTEMPT_RESTORE,
) -> NodeComponent:
    """Create or update a component from serialized data.

    Args:
        data (OrderedDict): serialized component.
        node (Node): node owning the component.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext): deserialization context.
        component (NodeComponent | None): existing component to update.
        restore_uuid: how the serialized uuid is restored.

    Returns:
        NodeComponent: deserialized component.
    """
    uuid = cls.choose_new_uuid(
        node.stage, serialized_data=data, restore_option=restore_uuid
    )
    if not component:
        component_cls = NYX_REGISTRY.get_node_component_cls(data[cls.TYPE_ID_KEY])
        component = component_cls(uuid=uuid)

    component.uuid = uuid
    context.register(serialized_uuid=data.get(cls.UUID_KEY), new_uuid=component.uuid)
    component.name = data["name"]
    component.display_name = data.get("display_name") or ""
    component.setData(
        data.get("datatype") or component.datatype_id, role=cls.Roles.DATATYPE
    )
    # Before the value: a literal component must not evaluate it while restoring.
    component.component_flags = (
        NodeComponentFlag(data["flags"]) | component.get_type_enforced_flags()
    )
    component.restore_value(data["value"], context)
    component.default_value = component.deserialize_default_value(
        value=data.get("default_value")
    )
    component.is_active = data["is_active"]
    note = data.get("note") or {}
    component.note = note.get("text", "")
    component.note_format = note.get("format", NoteFormat.PLAIN)

    return component

def get_display_value(self) -> str:
    """Get the display value, following the input link if there is one.

    Returns:
        str: display value, the one of the component itself if the linked value
            can't be pulled, like when the source points at something missing.
    """
    if self._providers.display is not None:
        return self._providers.display()
    if self.input_links:
        source = self.input_links[0].source_component
        try:
            source_value = source.pull_value()
        except Exception as err:
            LOGGER.debug("%s: can't show the linked value: %s", self.path, err)
            return self.data(role=self.Roles.DISPLAY_VALUE)
        value = self._cast_linked_value(source_value)
        if type(value) is type(source_value) and value == source_value:
            return source.get_display_value()
        return str(value)
    return self.data(role=self.Roles.DISPLAY_VALUE)

def get_initial_value(self) -> typing.Any:
    """Get the value a new component starts with.

    Returns:
        typing.Any: the default value of the component type, or the default of
            the datatype if the type has none or its one can't be cast to it.
    """
    value = self.get_type_default_value()
    datatype = self.datatype
    if value is None:
        return datatype.create_default()
    try:
        datatype.cast(value)
    except DatatypeCastError as err:
        LOGGER.warning(
            "Default value of %s is not valid for datatype %s, using the "
            "default of the datatype: %s",
            self.get_type_id(),
            datatype.display_name,
            err,
        )
        return datatype.create_default()
    return value

def is_linked_to(
    self, other_component: NodeComponent, as_source=False, as_target=False
) -> bool:
    """Check whether this component is linked to another one.

    Args:
        other_component (NodeComponent): component to check.
        as_source (bool): only count links where this component is the source.
        as_target (bool): only count links where this component is the target.

    Returns:
        bool: components are linked.
    """
    linked_as_source = False
    linked_as_target = False

    for link in self.links:
        if link.source == self.uuid and link.target == other_component.uuid:
            linked_as_source = True
        if link.source == other_component.uuid and link.target == self.uuid:
            linked_as_target = True
    if as_source:
        return linked_as_source
    if as_target:
        return linked_as_target
    return linked_as_source or linked_as_target

def pull_value(
    self, value_mask: NodeComponentValueMask = NodeComponentValueMask.CACHE
) -> typing.Any:
    """Get the value, following the input link if there is one.

    Args:
        value_mask (NodeComponentValueMask): which value to get.

    Returns:
        typing.Any: requested value.
    """
    if self._providers.pull is not None:
        return self._providers.pull(value_mask)
    input_links = self.input_links
    if input_links:
        value = input_links[0].source_component.pull_value(value_mask=value_mask)
        if value_mask is NodeComponentValueMask.CACHE:
            return self._cast_linked_value(value)
        return value

    return self.value_storage.pull(value_mask)

def rename_display(self, display_name: str) -> None:
    """Rename the component: set the display name, and the address name follows.

    The address name is made from the display name, with a number added when
    another component of the node has it already.

    Args:
        display_name (str): new display name.

    Raises:
        ValueError: the name has no letters or digits to make an address from.
    """
    display_name = display_name.strip()
    address_name = NameValidator.to_address_name(display_name)
    if not address_name:
        raise ValueError(f"Cannot make a component name out of {display_name!r}")
    if address_name != self.name:
        self.name = self.model().compose_unique_component_name(
            address_name, exclude=self
        )
    self.display_name = display_name
    self.emitDataChanged()

def set_component_flag(
    self, flag: NodeComponentFlag, role: NodeComponent.Roles, state: bool
):
    """Set or clear a component flag and notify the model.

    Args:
        flag (NodeComponentFlag): flag to change.
        role (NodeComponent.Roles): role reported as changed.
        state (bool): whether the flag is set.
    """
    if state:

    else:
        self.component_flags &= ~flag
    if self.model() is not None:
        self.model().dataChanged.emit(self.index(), self.index(), [role])

    plug_color: typing.Callable[[], QtGui.QColor] | None = None,

    Only the given providers change, the others are kept.

def remap_link(self, link_data: dict) -> dict | None:
    """Copy of link_data with endpoints created in this run remapped.

    Endpoints not created in this run are kept as they are (they already
    live in the stage). Returns None if the link touches nothing we created.
    """
    src_raw = UUID(str(link_data[Link.SOURCE_UUID_KEY]))
    tgt_raw = UUID(str(link_data[Link.TARGET_UUID_KEY]))
    src = self._uuid_map.get(src_raw)
    tgt = self._uuid_map.get(tgt_raw)

    if src is None and tgt is None:
        return None

    remapped = copy.copy(link_data)
    remapped[Link.SOURCE_UUID_KEY] = str(src if src is not None else src_raw)
    remapped[Link.TARGET_UUID_KEY] = str(tgt if tgt is not None else tgt_raw)
    return remapped

Source code in src/nyx/core/contexts/serialization.py 
def resolved_links(self) -> list[tuple[UUID, UUID]]:
    """Unique (source, target) pairs for all collected links."""
    pairs: list[tuple[UUID, UUID]] = []
    for data in self._raw_links:
        target_raw = StageObject.as_uuid(data[Link.TARGET_UUID_KEY])
        target_uuid = self._uuid_map.get(target_raw)
        if target_uuid is None:
            continue  # target is outside the paste - don't touch it

        source_raw = StageObject.as_uuid(data[Link.SOURCE_UUID_KEY])
        source_uuid = self._uuid_map.get(
            source_raw, source_raw
        )  # external source - keep it

        uuid_pair = (source_uuid, target_uuid)
        if uuid_pair not in pairs:
            pairs.append(uuid_pair)
    return pairs

def find(self, service_type: type) -> typing.Any | None:
    """Find a provided object, looking from the innermost scope outwards.

    Args:
        service_type (type): type of the object.

    Returns:
        Any | None: most recently provided instance of the type, None if there
            is none.
    """
    for scope in reversed(self._scopes):
        for service in reversed(scope.services):
            if isinstance(service, service_type):
                return service
    return None

def require(self, service_type: type) -> typing.Any:
    """Find a provided object that has to exist.

    Args:
        service_type (type): type of the object.

    Raises:
        LookupError: nothing of that type is provided in the open scopes.

    Returns:
        Any: most recently provided instance of the type.
    """
    service = self.find(service_type)
    if service is None:
        raise LookupError(
            f"No {service_type.__name__} provided, is the node inside "
            "a node that provides it?"
        )
    return service

def unwind(self) -> None:
    """Close every scope, the root one included, and start over with a new root.

    Used when a crawl ends, however it ends.
    """
    while self._scopes:
        self._close_scope(self._scopes.pop())
    self._scopes.append(ExecutionScope())

@profile(text="Plugins initialized in {seconds:.4f}s")
def initialize_plugins(self, include: list[str] | None = None):
    """Iterate over registry and initialize each plugin.

    Args:
        include (list[str] | None): type ids of the plugins to use. Only these are
            enabled, whatever state an earlier call left them in. All enabled
            plugins are initialized if omitted.
    """
    self.loader.load_plugins_from_paths()

    initialization_counter = 0
    for plugin_entry in NYX_REGISTRY.iter_plugin_entries():
        type_id = plugin_entry.plugin_cls.get_type_id()
        if include:
            # Exactly these plugins, also the ones that an earlier call left disabled
            plugin_entry.enabled = type_id in include

        if not plugin_entry.enabled:
            continue

        if plugin_entry.plugin_instance is not None:
            continue

        plugin_entry.initialize()
        initialization_counter += 1
        LOGGER.info(f"Initialized plugin: {type_id}")

    LOGGER.info(
        f"Initialized {initialization_counter}/{len(NYX_REGISTRY.plugins)} plugins"
    )
    NYX_REGISTRY.register_plugin_content()

@staticmethod
def register_plugin() -> typing.Callable[[NyxPlugin], NyxPlugin]:
    """Decorator for plugin registration

    Returns:
        Decorator function


    Example:
        ```python
        from nyx.api.v1 import NyxPlugin, NyxPluginManager

        @NyxPluginManager.register_plugin()
        class MyPlugin(NyxPlugin):

        @classmethod
        def get_type_id(cls) -> str:
            return "MyPlugin"
        ```
    """

    def _register_plugin_inner(plugin_cls: NyxPlugin) -> NyxPlugin:
        """Create new `NyxPluginRegistryEntry` for given plugin class.

        Args:
            plugin_cls: plugin class to register

        Returns:
            Same plugin class
        """
        try:
            NyxPluginManager.validate_plugin_class(plugin_cls)
        except Exception:
            LOGGER.exception("Failed to register %s", plugin_cls.__name__)
            return plugin_cls

        NYX_REGISTRY.add_plugin(plugin_cls)
        return plugin_cls

    return _register_plugin_inner

@staticmethod
def validate_plugin_class(plugin_cls: NyxPlugin) -> None:
    """Validate plugin class.

    Args:
        plugin_cls: plugin class to validate

    Raises:
        ValueError: Plugin NAME is not defined.
    """
    if not issubclass(plugin_cls, IRegistryEntry):
        raise TypeError(f"Not implemented {IRegistryEntry.__name__}: {plugin_cls}")

    if not plugin_cls.get_type_id():
        raise ValueError("Plugin has no type_id defined")

    type_id = plugin_cls.get_type_id()
    if type_id in NYX_REGISTRY.plugins:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Plugin with name {type_id} already exists:"
            f"{NYX_REGISTRY.plugins[type_id]}"
        )

def __del__(self) -> None:
    """Clear the undo stack while the python objects are still valid."""
    # Commands keep Python state alive; empty the undo stack while the Python
    # objects are still intact. Letting the C++ destructor clear it during
    # garbage collection can crash, since the commands' wrappers may be gone.
    try:
        if shiboken6.isValid(self) and shiboken6.isValid(self.undo_stack):
            # Silent: listeners (e.g. graph editors) may already be deleted.
            self.undo_stack.blockSignals(True)
            self.undo_stack.clear()
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - never raise from a finalizer
        pass

def collect_links(self, from_node: NodeLike | None = None) -> list[Link]:
    """Collect links touching a node and its descendants.

    Args:
        from_node (NodeLike | None): node to start from. Defaults to the root node.

    Returns:
        list[Link]: collected links.
    """
    result = []
    from_node = self.get_object(from_node) if from_node else self.root_node
    serialized_node = from_node.serialize()
    for link_data in serialized_node[Node.LINKS_KEY]:
        result.append(self.get_object(link_data[StageObject.UUID_KEY]))
    return result

def delete_node(
    self, nodes: Sequence[NodeLike] | NodeLike, ignore_lock: bool = False
) -> None:
    """Delete node from stage.

    Args:
        nodes: nodes to delete.
        ignore_lock (bool): delete locked nodes too, for the node owning them.

    """
    if not isinstance(nodes, Sequence):
        nodes = [nodes]
    for node in nodes:
        node = self.get_object(node)
        if node is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{self} | Failed to delete node.")

        if node.is_locked and not ignore_lock:
            raise RuntimeError("Can't delete locked node: %s", node.path)

        # Removed uuids for node, childrent and components
        self.unregister_node(node)

        parent = node.parent()
        self.removeRow(node.row(), parent.index())
        self.node_deleted.emit(node.uuid)

def filter_top_level_nodes(self, nodes: list[NodeLike]) -> list[Node]:
    """Drop nodes that have an ancestor in the given nodes.

    Args:
        nodes (list[NodeLike]): nodes to filter.

    Returns:
        list[Node]: nodes without ancestors in the input.
    """
    nodes: list[Node] = [self.get_object(node) for node in nodes]
    paths_set = {node.path for node in nodes}
    return [
        node for node in nodes if not set(node.path.parents).intersection(paths_set)
    ]

def generate_unique_node_name(
    self,
    base_name: str,
    parent_node: NodeLike | None = None,
    exclude: Node | None = None,
):
    """Generate a node name not used by the siblings under a parent.

    Args:
        base_name (str): preferred name.
        parent_node (NodeLike | None): parent node. Defaults to the root node.
        exclude (Node | None): sibling that does not count, e.g. the node being
            renamed.

    Returns:
        str: unique valid node name.
    """
    base_name = NameValidator.get_valid_stage_object_name(base_name)
    parent_node: Node = (
        self.get_object(parent_node) if parent_node else self.root_node
    )
    existing_children_names: set[str] = {
        child.name for child in parent_node.list_children() if child is not exclude
    }
    if base_name not in existing_children_names:
        return base_name

    index = 1
    result_name = base_name
    while result_name in existing_children_names:
        result_name = f"{base_name}{index}"
        index += 1
    return result_name

def get_object(
    self,
    stage_object: NodeLike | NodeComponentLike | LinkLike,
    expected_type: type[TStageObject] | None = None,
) -> TStageObject:
    """Get `nyx` stage object.

    Args:
        stage_object: Input to search object by.

    Returns:
        Found `Node`, `NodeComponent` or `Link` instance or None if not
    """
    original_request = stage_object
    result = None

    if isinstance(stage_object, StageObject):
        result = stage_object

    elif isinstance(stage_object, UUID):
        result = self.uuid_map.get(stage_object)

    elif isinstance(stage_object, pathlib.PurePosixPath):
        getter = (
            self.node_component_from_path
            if stage_object.suffix
            else self.node_from_path
        )
        result = getter(stage_object)

    elif isinstance(stage_object, str):
        try:
            result = self.get_object(UUID(stage_object, version=4))
        except ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError:
            result = self.get_object(pathlib.PurePosixPath(stage_object))

    if result is None:
        raise StageObjectQueryError(
            f"Failed to get object from request: {original_request}"
        )
    if expected_type is not None and not isinstance(result, expected_type):
        raise StageObjectQueryError(
            f"Expected result from {original_request} is of type "
            f"{expected_type.__name__}, got {type(result).__name__} instead"
        )

    return result

def link_components(
    self,
    source_component: NodeComponentLike,
    target_component: NodeComponentLike,
    use_uuid: UUID | str | None = None,
) -> Link:
    """Link two components and register the link.

    Args:
        source_component (NodeComponentLike): component providing output.
        target_component (NodeComponentLike): component accepting input.
        use_uuid (UUID | str | None): uuid for the link. Generated if omitted.

    Returns:
        Link: created link.

    Raises:
        NodeComponentLinkError: if the components can't be linked.
    """
    source_component: NodeComponent = self.get_object(source_component)
    target_component: NodeComponent = self.get_object(target_component)

    if not source_component.readable:
        raise NodeComponentLinkError(f"Not readable component: {source_component}")

    if not target_component.writable:
        raise NodeComponentLinkError(f"Not writable component: {target_component}")

    if not target_component.accepts_datatype_of(source_component):
        raise NodeComponentLinkError(
            f"Incompatible datatypes: {source_component.datatype.display_name} "
            f"to {target_component.datatype.display_name}"
        )

    if source_component.single_output and source_component.output_links:
        raise NodeComponentLinkError(
            f"Component allows a single output link: {source_component}"
        )

    if self.would_link_create_cycle(source_component, target_component):
        raise NodeComponentLinkError(
            f"Link would create a cycle between nodes: {source_component} "
            f"to {target_component}"
        )

    new_link = Link(
        stage=self,
        source=source_component.uuid,
        target=target_component.uuid,
        uuid=use_uuid,
    )
    self.register_link(link=new_link)
    return new_link

def node_component_from_path(
    self, path: pathlib.PurePosixPath | str
) -> NodeComponent | None:
    """Find a node component by path.

    Args:
        path (pathlib.PurePosixPath | str): component path.

    Returns:
        NodeComponent | None: component, None if the node has no such component.

    Raises:
        ValueError: if the path isn't a component path or its node doesn't exist.
    """
    path = pathlib.PurePosixPath(path)
    component_name = path.suffix
    if not component_name:
        raise ValueError(f"Not valid component path: {path}")

    node_path = path.with_suffix("")
    node = self.get_object(node_path)
    if not node:
        raise ValueError(f"Node for given component path doesn't exist: {path}")

    return node.components_model.get_component(component_name)

def node_from_path(self, path: pathlib.PurePosixPath | str) -> Node | None:
    """Find a node by path.

    Args:
        path (pathlib.PurePosixPath | str): node path.

    Returns:
        Node | None: node, None if the path doesn't exist.
    """
    path = pathlib.PurePosixPath(path)
    if path == ROOT_NODE_PATH:
        return self.item(0)

    segments = path.parts[1:]  # drop the leading "/"
    if not segments or segments[0] != ROOT_NODE_PATH.name:
        return None

    current = self.root_node
    for name in segments[1:]:
        current = current.find_child_by_name(name)
        if current is None:
            return None
    return current

    self, stage_object: StageObject | UUID | pathlib.PurePosixPath | str
) -> pathlib.PurePosixPath:
    """Convert a stage object, uuid or path-like value to a path.

    Args:
        stage_object (StageObject | UUID | pathlib.PurePosixPath | str): value to
            convert.

    Returns:
        pathlib.PurePosixPath: path of the object.
    """
    if isinstance(stage_object, pathlib.PurePosixPath):
        return stage_object
    elif isinstance(stage_object, str):
        try:
            uuid = UUID(stage_object)
            return self.get_object(uuid).path
        except Exception:
            return pathlib.PurePosixPath(stage_object)
    elif isinstance(stage_object, StageObject):
        return stage_object.path
    elif isinstance(stage_object, UUID):
        return self.get_object(stage_object).path

def push_command(self, *commands: NyxCommand):
    """Push command to stage's undo stack.
    Also validates command before pushing and raises error if validation fails.

    Args:
        commands (NyxCommand): command to push.
    Raises:
        NyxCommandValidationError: if command validation fails.
    """
    for command in commands:
        if self is not command.stage:
            raise ValueError("Command stage doesn't match current stage.")
        command.validate()
        command.validate_not_locked()

    for command in commands:
        self.undo_stack.push(command)

def register_link(self, link: Link):
    """Register a link and attach it to both of its components.

    Args:
        link (Link): link to register. Invalid links are skipped.

    Raises:
        StageObjectRegistrationError: if the uuid is used by another object.
    """
    if not link.is_valid:
        LOGGER.warning(f"Skipping registration of invalid link: {link}")
        return

    if link.uuid in self._uuid_map and self._uuid_map[link.uuid] is not link:
        raise StageObjectRegistrationError(
            f"Link with UUID {link.uuid} already exists: "
            f"{(self.get_object(link.uuid, expected_type=Link))}"
        )

    self._uuid_map[link.uuid] = link
    source_cpnt: NodeComponent = self.get_object(link.source)
    target_cpnt: NodeComponent = self.get_object(link.target)
    source_cpnt.add_link(link_uuid=link.uuid)
    target_cpnt.add_link(link_uuid=link.uuid)
    LOGGER.debug("Registered link: %s (%s)", str(link), str(link.uuid))

def total_node_count(self) -> int:
    """Get total number of nodes in the stage.

    Returns:
        int: number of nodes in the stage.
    """

    def count_parent(parent_index: QtCore.QModelIndex):
        """Count children of given parent index.

        Args:
            parent_index (QModelIndex): parent index

        Returns:
            int: number of child nodes
        """
        total = 0
        rows = self.rowCount(parent_index)
        for row in range(rows):
            index = self.index(row, 0, parent_index)
            total += 1
            total += count_parent(index)
        return total

    return count_parent(self.root_node.index())

def unregister_node(self, node: NodeLike):
    """Unregister a node, its components and its descendants.

    Args:
        node (NodeLike): node to unregister.

    Raises:
        StageObjectUnregistrationError: if the node is the root node.
    """
    if node is self.root_node:
        raise StageObjectUnregistrationError("Can't unregister root node")

    node: Node = self.get_object(node)
    self._uuid_map.pop(node.uuid, None)
    for util_object in node.util_objects:
        self._uuid_map.pop(util_object.uuid, None)
    descendant_nodes = node.list_children_tree()
    for component in node.components_model.list_components():
        self._uuid_map.pop(component.uuid, None)
        # Links left are the ones inside what is removed, like the internal
        # links of a reference node.
        for link_uuid in component.links_uuids:
            self._uuid_map.pop(link_uuid, None)

    for child_node in descendant_nodes:
        self.unregister_node(child_node)

Check whether a link would make values depend on themselves.

Between two nodes the nodes are looked at, not the components: nodes can't take values from each other in both directions, whatever components the links are between. Inside of a node only the components count, they can be linked to each other as long as the values don't loop back. Flow links count too, loops are made with loop nodes that run their body, not with circular links.

def would_link_create_cycle(
    self, source_component: NodeComponent, target_component: NodeComponent
) -> bool:
    """Check whether a link would make values depend on themselves.

    Between two nodes the nodes are looked at, not the components: nodes can't take
    values from each other in both directions, whatever components the links are
    between. Inside of a node only the components count, they can be linked to
    each other as long as the values don't loop back. Flow links count too, loops
    are made with loop nodes that run their body, not with circular links.

    Args:
        source_component (NodeComponent): component providing output.
        target_component (NodeComponent): component accepting input.

    Returns:
        bool: the source already depends on the target (the node of the source on
            the node of the target), or both are the same component.
    """
    if source_component is target_component:
        return True

    if source_component.node is target_component.node:
        start, goal = target_component, source_component
        next_of = self._find_dependent_components
    else:
        start, goal = target_component.node, source_component.node
        next_of = self._find_dependent_nodes

    pending = [start]
    reached = {start.uuid}
    while pending:
        item = pending.pop()
        if item is goal:
            return True
        for next_item in next_of(item):
            if next_item.uuid not in reached:
                reached.add(next_item.uuid)
                pending.append(next_item)
    return False

@staticmethod
def as_uuid(value: StageObject | UUID | str | None, strict: bool = False) -> UUID:
    """Convert a value to a uuid.

    Args:
        value (StageObject | UUID | str | None): object, uuid or uuid string.
        strict (bool): raise on None instead of generating a new uuid.

    Returns:
        UUID: converted uuid.

    Raises:
        ValueError: if value is None and strict is set.
        TypeError: if value is of an unsupported type.
    """
    if isinstance(value, StageObject):
        return value.uuid
    if isinstance(value, UUID):
        return value
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        return UUID(value)
    elif value is None:
        if not strict:
            return uuid4()
        raise ValueError(f"UUID must be of type UUID | str, got {value}")
    else:
        raise TypeError(f"Invalid UUID input: {value}")

@classmethod
def choose_new_uuid(
    cls,
    stage: Stage | None,
    serialized_data: OrderedDict[str, typing.Any],
    restore_option: RestoreUuidOption,
) -> UUID:
    """Pick the uuid for a deserialized object.

    Args:
        stage (Stage | None): stage used to detect uuid collisions.
        serialized_data (OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]): serialized object.
        restore_option (RestoreUuidOption): uuid restore strategy.

    Returns:
        UUID: uuid to use.
    """
    if restore_option is RestoreUuidOption.GENERATE_NEW:
        return uuid4()

    serialized_uuid = cls.as_uuid(serialized_data[cls.UUID_KEY])

    if restore_option is RestoreUuidOption.RESTORE:
        return serialized_uuid
    elif restore_option is RestoreUuidOption.ATTEMPT_RESTORE:
        if stage is None:
            return serialized_uuid

        return serialized_uuid if serialized_uuid not in stage.uuid_map else uuid4()

@classmethod
def deserialize(
    cls,
    node: Node,
    serialized_data: typing.Mapping[str, typing.Any],
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption = RestoreUuidOption.ATTEMPT_RESTORE,
    context: NodeDeserializationContext | None = None,
) -> UtilObject | None:
    """Create a util object from serialized data and add it to a node.

    Args:
        node (Node): node to add the object to.
        serialized_data (typing.Mapping[str, typing.Any]): serialized object.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how the serialized uuid is restored.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext | None): deserialization context.

    Returns:
        UtilObject | None: new object, None if its type isn't registered.
    """
    util_object_cls = NYX_REGISTRY.get_util_object_cls(
        serialized_data[cls.TYPE_ID_KEY]
    )
    if util_object_cls is None:
        return None

    uuid = cls.choose_new_uuid(
        stage=node.stage,
        serialized_data=serialized_data,
        restore_option=restore_uuid,
    )
    util_object = util_object_cls(uuid=uuid)
    util_object.apply_properties(serialized_data)
    node.add_util_object(util_object)
    if context is not None:
        context.register(
            serialized_uuid=serialized_data[cls.UUID_KEY], new_uuid=util_object.uuid
        )
    return util_object

def cast_value(self, value: typing.Any) -> typing.Any:
    """Cast an evaluated value to the component datatype.

    A missing value (None) becomes the default of the datatype, if it has one.

    Args:
        value (typing.Any): evaluated value.

    Raises:
        DatatypeCastError: the value can't be converted.

    Returns:
        typing.Any: converted value.
    """
    datatype = self.component.datatype
    if value is None:
        value = datatype.create_default()
    if value is None:
        return None
    return datatype.cast(value)

def compute_value(self) -> typing.Any:
    """Compute the evaluated value. Strings are evaluated as python expressions.

    Returns:
        typing.Any: evaluated value, the raw value if evaluation fails or the
            component is literal.
    """
    out_value = self.raw_value
    if self.component.is_literal:
        return out_value
    if isinstance(self.raw_value, str) and self.raw_value:
        try:
            out_value = eval(self.raw_value)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return out_value

def evaluate(self) -> None:
    """Evaluate the raw value and store the result as the cached value.

    The value is cast to the component datatype. When that fails the previous
    cached value is kept and the storage becomes invalid.
    """
    try:
        self.set_cached_value(self.cast_value(self.compute_value()))
    except DatatypeCastError as err:
        LOGGER.warning(str(err))
        self._set_cast_error(str(err))
    else:
        self._set_cast_error(None)

def pull(self, value_mask: NodeComponentValueMask) -> typing.Any:
    """Get a value of the storage.

    Args:
        value_mask (NodeComponentValueMask): which value to get.

    Returns:
        typing.Any: requested value.

    if value_mask is NodeComponentValueMask.RAW:

    elif value_mask is NodeComponentValueMask.CACHE:
        return self.cached_value
    elif value_mask is NodeComponentValueMask.DISPLAY:
        return self.display_value

docs.title: ExecutionChain
docs.text:
Finds the nodes the execution flow reaches.

The flow of a scope begins at its flow start node and follows the flow components from node to node, like StageCrawler does. Only active flow components lead on: before a node is evaluated all its outputs are active, afterwards a branch or sequence has switched off the ones it did not choose.

find_flow_hops is the one rule for where the flow goes from a node, used by the crawler to execute and by the editor to show the chain.

@staticmethod
def find_flow_hops(node: Node) -> typing.Iterator[tuple[FlowComponent, Node]]:
    """Find where the flow goes from a node.

    Only flow components that are readable (not write-only data links) and active
    (not switched off by a branch or sequence) lead on, and only when linked.

    Args:
        node (Node): node the flow leaves.

    Yields:
        tuple[FlowComponent, Node]: flow component and the node its link leads to,
            wherever that node is in the stage.
    """
    if not node.is_active():
        return
    for flow_component in node.components_model.find_readable_flow_components():
        next_node = flow_component.get_next_node()
        if next_node is not None:
            yield flow_component, next_node

@staticmethod
def find_node_uuids(scope_node: Node) -> frozenset[UUID]:
    """Find the nodes of a scope the execution flow reaches.

    The scope itself has to be reached by the flow of its parent scope, and so on
    up to the root, otherwise nothing in it ever runs.

    Args:
        scope_node (Node): node whose children are checked.

    Returns:
        frozenset[UUID]: uuids of the children on the chain. Empty if the scope
            is not reached or has no flow start node.
    """
    if not ExecutionChain._is_scope_reached(scope_node):
        return frozenset()
    return ExecutionChain._walk_scope(scope_node)

def execute(self):
    """Call the function with the parameter values and store its result."""
    args = []
    kwargs = {}
    for parameter in self.PARAMETERS:
        value = self.parameter_cpnts[parameter.name].pull_value()
        if parameter.kind is inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_ONLY:
            args.append(value)
        else:
            kwargs[parameter.name] = value
    # Not evaluated: a string result would be run as an expression otherwise
    self.return_cpnt.push_value(self.FUNCTION(*args, **kwargs), evaluate=False)

def setup(self):
    """Add the flow, parameter and return components."""
    self.flow_cpnt = self.components_model.create_component(CoreNodeComponents.FLOW)
    self.flow_cpnt.name = "flow"
    self.flow_cpnt.readable = True
    self.flow_cpnt.writable = True
    self.components_model.add_component(self.flow_cpnt)

    self.parameter_cpnts = {}
    for parameter in self.PARAMETERS:
        component = self.components_model.create_component(CoreNodeComponents.VALUE)
        component.name = parameter.name
        component.writable = True
        component.is_editable = True
        if description := self.PARAMETER_DESCRIPTIONS.get(parameter.name):
            component.description = description
        component.set_datatype(
            find_datatype_id(self.PARAMETER_HINTS.get(parameter.name))
        )
        if parameter.default is not inspect.Parameter.empty:
            component.default_value = parameter.default
            component.push_value(parameter.default)
        self.components_model.add_component(component)
        self.parameter_cpnts[parameter.name] = component

    self.return_cpnt = self.components_model.create_component(
        CoreNodeComponents.VALUE
    )
    self.return_cpnt.name = RETURN_COMPONENT_NAME
    self.return_cpnt.readable = True
    self.return_cpnt.is_editable = False
    if self.RETURN_DESCRIPTION:
        self.return_cpnt.description = self.RETURN_DESCRIPTION
    self.return_cpnt.set_datatype(find_datatype_id(self.RETURN_ANNOTATION))
    self.components_model.add_component(self.return_cpnt)

def create_function_node_class(
    func: typing.Callable,
    type_id: str | None = None,
    tags: typing.Iterable[str] = (),
) -> type[FunctionNode]:
    """Generate a node type that calls a function.

    Args:
        func (typing.Callable): function to call. Its type hints choose the datatypes.
        type_id (str | None): node type id. Derived from the module and name of the
            function if omitted.
        tags (typing.Iterable[str]): tags of the node besides "function".

    Raises:
        TypeError: func is not a function with a name.

    Returns:
        type[FunctionNode]: new node class.
    """
    name = getattr(func, "__name__", None)
    if not callable(func) or not name or name == "<lambda>":
        raise TypeError(f"Can't create a node from {func!r}: not a named function")

    try:
        hints = typing.get_type_hints(func)
    except Exception:
        LOGGER.warning("Can't resolve the type hints of %s", name, exc_info=True)
        hints = dict(getattr(func, "__annotations__", {}))

    signature = inspect.signature(func)
    parameters = []
    for parameter in signature.parameters.values():
        if parameter.kind in (
            inspect.Parameter.VAR_POSITIONAL,
            inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD,
        ):
            LOGGER.warning("Parameter %s of %s is skipped", parameter.name, name)
            continue
        parameters.append(parameter)

    argument_descriptions, return_description = parse_docstring(inspect.getdoc(func))
    module = getattr(func, "__module__", "")
    qualname = getattr(func, "__qualname__", name)
    return typing.cast(
        type[FunctionNode],
        type(
            f"{name.title().replace('_', '')}Node",
            (FunctionNode,),
            {
                "DEFAULT_NAME": name,
                "FUNCTION": staticmethod(func),
                "FUNCTION_TYPE_ID": type_id or f"function:{module}.{qualname}",
                "FUNCTION_TAGS": frozenset(tags),
                "PARAMETER_DESCRIPTIONS": argument_descriptions,
                "RETURN_DESCRIPTION": return_description,
                "PARAMETERS": tuple(parameters),
                "PARAMETER_HINTS": {
                    parameter.name: hints.get(parameter.name) for parameter in parameters
                },
                "RETURN_ANNOTATION": hints.get("return", inspect.Signature.empty),
                "__doc__": inspect.getdoc(func) or f"Node calling {name}.",
            },
        ),
    )

def find_datatype_id(annotation: typing.Any) -> str:
    """Find the datatype for a type hint.

    Args:
        annotation (typing.Any): type hint. `X | None` counts as `X`, and a generic like
            `list[int]` as the class it is made from, `list`.

    Returns:
        str: type id of the registered datatype of the type, object if there is none.
    """
    annotation = _strip_optional(annotation)
    annotation = typing.get_origin(annotation) or annotation
    if isinstance(annotation, type):
        datatype = NYX_REGISTRY.find_datatype_for_type(annotation)
        if datatype is not None:
            return datatype.type_id
    return CoreDatatypes.OBJECT.value

def find_public_functions(module: types.ModuleType) -> list[typing.Callable]:
    """Get the functions defined in a module, in definition order.

    Args:
        module (types.ModuleType): module to look at.

    Returns:
        list[typing.Callable]: public functions of the module itself, not imported ones.
    """
    return [
        value
        for name, value in vars(module).items()
        if isinstance(value, types.FunctionType)
        and value.__module__ == module.__name__
        and not name.startswith("_")
    ]

def parse_docstring(docstring: str | None) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str]:
    """Read the parameter and return descriptions of a Google style docstring.

    Args:
        docstring (str | None): docstring of a function.

    Returns:
        tuple[dict[str, str], str]: descriptions of the parameters by name, and the
            description of the return value: the `Returns:` section if there is one,
            else the first line of the docstring.
    """
    text = inspect.cleandoc(docstring or "")
    summary = text.split("\n", 1)[0].strip()
    arguments: dict[str, str] = {}
    returns = ""
    section = ""
    name = ""
    for line in text.splitlines()[1:]:
        stripped = line.strip()
        header = re.fullmatch(r"(Args|Arguments|Returns|Raises|Yields):", stripped)
        if header and not line.startswith(" "):
            section, name = header.group(1), ""
            continue
        if not stripped:
            continue
        if not line.startswith(" "):
            section, name = "", ""
        elif section in ("Args", "Arguments"):
            match = re.match(r"\s+(\w+)\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?:\s*(.*)", line)
            if match and len(line) - len(line.lstrip()) <= 4:
                name = match.group(1)
                arguments[name] = match.group(2).strip()
            elif name:
                arguments[name] += " " + stripped
        elif section == "Returns":
            returns = f"{returns} {stripped}".strip()
    # A type before the text, like "str: the result"
    returns = re.sub(r"^[\w.\[\]]+(?: \| [\w.\[\]]+)*:\s+", "", returns)
    return arguments, returns or summary

@classmethod
def deserialize(
    cls,
    stage: Stage,
    serialized_link: OrderedDict[str, typing.Any],
    link: Link | None = None,
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption = RestoreUuidOption.ATTEMPT_RESTORE,
):
    """Create or update a link from serialized data.

    Args:
        stage (Stage): target stage.
        serialized_link (OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]): serialized link.
        link (Link | None): existing link to update. A new one is created if omitted.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how the serialized uuid is restored.

    Returns:
        Link: deserialized link.
    """
    new_uuid = cls.choose_new_uuid(
        stage=stage,
        serialized_data=serialized_link,
        restore_option=restore_uuid,
    )
    if not link:
        link = cls(
            stage=stage,
            source=serialized_link[cls.SOURCE_UUID_KEY],
            target=serialized_link[cls.TARGET_UUID_KEY],
            uuid=new_uuid,
        )
    else:
        link.uuid = new_uuid

    link._pins = [
        QtCore.QPointF(x, y) for x, y in serialized_link.get(cls.PINS_KEY, ())
    ]
    return link

@classmethod
def is_registered(cls, stage: Stage, link: LinkLike) -> bool:
    """Is the link valid and known by both of its components.

    Args:
        stage (Stage): stage to search.
        link (LinkLike): link, uuid or path.

    Returns:
        bool: link is registered on both components.
    """
    try:
        link: Link = stage.get_object(link)
    except StageObjectQueryError:
        return False

    if not link.is_valid:
        return False

    present_in_source = link.uuid in link.source_component.links_uuids
    present_in_target = link.uuid in link.target_component.links_uuids

    return all([present_in_source, present_in_target])

def serialize(self) -> OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]:
    """Serialize the link, including the relative path between its ends.

    Returns:
        OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]: serialized data.
    """
    serialized_data = super().serialize()
    serialized_data[self.META_DATA_KEY].update(
        {
            "relative_path": StagePathResolver.compute_relative_path(
                source_path=self.source_path, destination_path=self.target_path
            ).as_posix()
        }
    )
    serialized_data[self.SOURCE_UUID_KEY] = str(self.source)
    serialized_data[self.TARGET_UUID_KEY] = str(self.target)
    if self._pins:
        serialized_data[self.PINS_KEY] = [[pin.x(), pin.y()] for pin in self._pins]
    return serialized_data

@classmethod
def get_valid_stage_object_name(cls, name: str) -> str:
    """Convert a name into a valid stage object name.

    Special characters are dropped and whitespace becomes underscores.

    Args:
        name (str): name to sanitize.

    Returns:
        str: valid name (unchanged if already valid).
    """
    if cls.is_valid_object_name(name):
        return name

    new_name = re.sub(
        r"[^A-Za-z0-9_\s]", "", name
    )  # drop special chars, keep underscores/whitespace
    new_name = re.sub(
        r"\s+", "_", new_name.strip()
    )  # whitespace runs -> single underscore
    new_name = re.sub(r"_+", "_", new_name).strip("_")  # collapse/trim underscores

    LOGGER.warning("Removed invalid characters from %s result: %s", name, new_name)
    return new_name

def humanize(address_name: str) -> str:
    """Make a display name out of an address name.

    Args:

        str: words with their first letter capitalized, like "Client Name".

def appendRow(self, items: Node | typing.Sequence[Node]) -> None:
    """Override Qt method.

    - Generates new unique name.
    - Set cached path to current.
    - Store path into stage path map.

    Args:
        items (typing.Sequence): items to append.

    Raises:
        ValueError: path exists in stage path map.

    """
    if not isinstance(items, typing.Sequence):
        items = [items]

    for node in items:
        unique_name = self.stage.generate_unique_node_name(
            node.name, parent_node=self
        )
        node.setData(unique_name, role=Node.Roles.NAME)
        self.stage.register_node(node)
        super().appendRow(node)
        node.refresh_label()
        node.setup()
        node.post_setup_hook()

@classmethod
def deserialize(
    cls,
    serialized_node: OrderedDict[str, typing.Any],
    node: Node | None = None,
    parent_node: Node | None = None,
    context: NodeDeserializationContext | None = None,
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption = RestoreUuidOption.ATTEMPT_RESTORE,
) -> Node:
    """Create or update a node and its contents from serialized data.

    Components, children and links are restored with the node.

    Args:
        serialized_node (OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]): serialized node.
        node (Node | None): existing node to update.
        parent_node (Node | None): parent of the created node.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext | None): deserialization context.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how serialized uuids are restored.

    Returns:
        Node: deserialized node.

    Raises:
        ValueError: if neither node nor parent_node is given.
    """
    if not (node or parent_node):
        raise ValueError(
            "Either parent node or node must be provided for deserialization."
        )

    stage = parent_node.stage if parent_node else node.stage
    uuid = cls.choose_new_uuid(
        stage=stage,
        serialized_data=serialized_node,
        restore_option=restore_uuid,
    )

    if not node:
        node_cls = NYX_REGISTRY.get_node_cls(serialized_node[cls.TYPE_ID_KEY])
        node = node_cls(
            name=serialized_node[cls.NAME_KEY],
            uuid=uuid,
            parent=parent_node,
            display_name=cls._read_display_name(serialized_node),
        )
    else:
        node.rename(serialized_node[cls.NAME_KEY])
        if not node.is_stage_root_node:  # the root is always called "stage"
            node.set_display_name(cls._read_display_name(serialized_node))

    context = context or NodeDeserializationContext(
        stage=stage,
        entry_node=node,
    )
    if context.entry_node is None:
        context.entry_node = node

    LOGGER.debug(f"Deserializing: {serialized_node.get(cls.NAME_KEY)}")
    if uuid is not None:
        node.uuid = uuid

    context.register(
        serialized_uuid=serialized_node[cls.UUID_KEY], new_uuid=node.uuid
    )
    links_data = serialized_node.get(cls.LINKS_KEY, [])

    # Roles that should exist for normal and reference nodes
    node.set_active(serialized_node.get(cls.ACTIVE_KEY, True))
    node.set_position(
        QtCore.QPointF(*serialized_node.get(cls.POSITION_KEY, [0.0, 0.0]))
    )
    node.execution_order = serialized_node.get(
        cls.EXECUTION_ORDER_KEY, cls.get_type_execution_order()
    )

    node.deserialize_contents(
        serialized_node, context=context, restore_uuid=restore_uuid
    )
    stage.register_node(node)

    # Links
    if context.defer_links:
        context.collect_links(links_data)
    elif context.entry_node is node:
        node.deserialize_links(
            links_data=links_data, restore_uuid=restore_uuid, context=context
        )

    # Everything this run creates exists now: let object paths find their targets.
    # With deferred links the caller owns the run and does it once all is created.
    if context.entry_node is node and not context.defer_links:
        context.run_deferred()

    return node

def deserialize_contents(
    self,
    serialized_node: OrderedDict[str, typing.Any],
    context: NodeDeserializationContext,
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption,
) -> None:
    """Create the children and components of the node from serialized data.

    Override in subclasses that get their contents from somewhere else.

    Args:
        serialized_node (OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]): serialized node.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext): deserialization context.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how serialized uuids are restored.
    """
    for child_data in serialized_node.get(self.CHILDREN_KEY, {}):
        self.deserialize(
            serialized_node=child_data,
            parent_node=self,
            restore_uuid=restore_uuid,
            context=context,
        )

    self.components_model.deserialize(
        serialized_node.get(self.COMPONENTS_KEY, []),
        context=context,
        restore_uuid=restore_uuid,
    )
    self.deserialize_util_objects(
        serialized_node.get(self.UTIL_OBJECTS_KEY, []),
        context=context,
        restore_uuid=restore_uuid,
    )

def deserialize_links(
    self,
    links_data: list[OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]],
    restore_uuid: RestoreUuidOption,
    context: NodeDeserializationContext,
):
    """Create links from serialized data.

    Args:
        links_data (list[OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]]): serialized links.
        restore_uuid (RestoreUuidOption): how serialized uuids are restored.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext): deserialization context.
    """
    for each_link_data in links_data:
        link_data = context.remap_link(each_link_data)
        if link_data is None:
            continue
        link = Link.deserialize(
            stage=self.stage,
            serialized_link=link_data,
            link=None,
            restore_uuid=restore_uuid,
        )
        self.stage.register_link(link)

def execution_hook(self):
    """Execute this node.

    Raises:
        err: run time exception raised during code execution.

    """
    self.reset_execution_status()
    if not self.is_active():
        return

    self.execution_status = NodeExecutionStatus.PENDING
    start_time = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        self.pre_execution_hook()
        self.evaluate_components()
        self.evaluate()
        self.execute_components()
        self.execute()
        self.post_execution_hook()
    except StageExecutionCancelled:
        self.execution_status = NodeExecutionStatus.NOT_RAN
        raise
    except Exception as err:
        LOGGER.exception(f"{self} | Execution error: {err}")
        self.raised_exception = err
        self.execution_status = NodeExecutionStatus.ERROR
        self.stage.execution_failed.emit(self)
        raise err
    else:
        self.execution_status = NodeExecutionStatus.SUCCESS

    total_time = time.perf_counter() - start_time
    LOGGER.info(f"Executed in {total_time:.4f}: {self.path}")

def list_parents(self, as_queue: bool = False) -> list[Node] | deque[Node]:
    """List parents recursively.

    Args:
        as_queue: If result should be returned as deque. Defaults to False.

    Returns:
        list[Node] | deque[Node]: parent nodes collection.

    """
    parents = deque()
    direct_parent: Node = self.parent()
    if direct_parent and not direct_parent.is_stage_root_node:
        parents.appendleft(self.parent())
        parents.extendleft(self.parent().list_parents())
    return parents if as_queue else list(parents)

def serialize(
    self, context: NodeSerializationContext | None = None
) -> OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]:
    """Serialize node to dict.

    Returns:
        OrderedDict: serialized data

    """
    context = context or NodeSerializationContext(stage=self.stage, entry_node=self)

    serialized_data = super().serialize()
    serialized_data[self.NAME_KEY] = self.name
    serialized_data[self.DISPLAY_NAME_KEY] = self.display_name
    serialized_data[self.TYPE_ID_KEY] = self.get_type_id()
    serialized_data[self.ACTIVE_KEY] = self.is_active()
    serialized_data[self.POSITION_KEY] = self.serializable_position()
    serialized_data[self.EXECUTION_ORDER_KEY] = self.execution_order
    serialized_data.update(self.serialize_contents(context))
    self.collect_serialized_links(context)

    if context.entry_node is self:
        serialized_data[Node.LINKS_KEY] = context.get_serialized_links()
    return serialized_data

def serialize_contents(
    self, context: NodeSerializationContext
) -> OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]:
    """Serialize what the node holds: its components and children.

    Override in subclasses that get their contents from somewhere else.

    Args:
        context (NodeSerializationContext): serialization context.

    Returns:
        OrderedDict[str, typing.Any]: data merged into the serialized node.
    """
    contents = OrderedDict(self.components_model.serialize())
    contents[self.CHILDREN_KEY] = [
        child_node.serialize(context=context) for child_node in self.list_children()
    ]
    contents[self.UTIL_OBJECTS_KEY] = [
        util_object.serialize() for util_object in self.util_objects
    ]
    return contents

def __lshift__(self, other: NodeComponent | pathlib.PurePosixPath | str) -> Link:
    """Handle `self << other` operator

    Args:
        other: other component or component path

    Raises:
        ValueError: Component with given path wasn't found in the stage.
    """
    other_component = self.node.stage.get_object(other)
    if not isinstance(other_component, NodeComponent):
        raise ValueError(f"Not a valid component path: {other}")

    return self.stage.link_components(
        source_component=other_component, target_component=self
    )

@classmethod
def deserialize(
    cls,
    data: OrderedDict,
    node: Node,
    context: NodeDeserializationContext,
    component: NodeComponent | None = None,
    restore_uuid=RestoreUuidOption.ATTEMPT_RESTORE,
) -> NodeComponent:
    """Create or update a component from serialized data.

    Args:
        data (OrderedDict): serialized component.
        node (Node): node owning the component.
        context (NodeDeserializationContext): deserialization context.
        component (NodeComponent | None): existing component to update.
        restore_uuid: how the serialized uuid is restored.

    Returns:
        NodeComponent: deserialized component.
    """
    uuid = cls.choose_new_uuid(
        node.stage, serialized_data=data, restore_option=restore_uuid
    )
    if not component:
        component_cls = NYX_REGISTRY.get_node_component_cls(data[cls.TYPE_ID_KEY])
        component = component_cls(uuid=uuid)

    component.uuid = uuid
    context.register(serialized_uuid=data.get(cls.UUID_KEY), new_uuid=component.uuid)
    component.name = data["name"]
    component.display_name = data.get("display_name") or ""
    component.setData(
        data.get("datatype") or component.datatype_id, role=cls.Roles.DATATYPE
    )
    # Before the value: a literal component must not evaluate it while restoring.
    component.component_flags = (
        NodeComponentFlag(data["flags"]) | component.get_type_enforced_flags()
    )
    component.restore_value(data["value"], context)
    component.default_value = component.deserialize_default_value(
        value=data.get("default_value")
    )
    component.is_active = data["is_active"]
    note = data.get("note") or {}
    component.note = note.get("text", "")
    component.note_format = note.get("format", NoteFormat.PLAIN)

    return component

def get_display_value(self) -> str:
    """Get the display value, following the input link if there is one.

    Returns:
        str: display value, the one of the component itself if the linked value
            can't be pulled, like when the source points at something missing.
    """
    if self._providers.display is not None:
        return self._providers.display()
    if self.input_links:
        source = self.input_links[0].source_component
        try:
            source_value = source.pull_value()
        except Exception as err:
            LOGGER.debug("%s: can't show the linked value: %s", self.path, err)
            return self.data(role=self.Roles.DISPLAY_VALUE)
        value = self._cast_linked_value(source_value)
        if type(value) is type(source_value) and value == source_value:
            return source.get_display_value()
        return str(value)
    return self.data(role=self.Roles.DISPLAY_VALUE)

def get_initial_value(self) -> typing.Any:
    """Get the value a new component starts with.

    Returns:
        typing.Any: the default value of the component type, or the default of
            the datatype if the type has none or its one can't be cast to it.
    """
    value = self.get_type_default_value()
    datatype = self.datatype
    if value is None:
        return datatype.create_default()
    try:
        datatype.cast(value)
    except DatatypeCastError as err:
        LOGGER.warning(
            "Default value of %s is not valid for datatype %s, using the "
            "default of the datatype: %s",
            self.get_type_id(),
            datatype.display_name,
            err,
        )
        return datatype.create_default()
    return value

def is_linked_to(
    self, other_component: NodeComponent, as_source=False, as_target=False
) -> bool:
    """Check whether this component is linked to another one.

    Args:
        other_component (NodeComponent): component to check.
        as_source (bool): only count links where this component is the source.
        as_target (bool): only count links where this component is the target.

    Returns:
        bool: components are linked.
    """
    linked_as_source = False
    linked_as_target = False

    for link in self.links:
        if link.source == self.uuid and link.target == other_component.uuid:
            linked_as_source = True
        if link.source == other_component.uuid and link.target == self.uuid:
            linked_as_target = True
    if as_source:
        return linked_as_source
    if as_target:
        return linked_as_target
    return linked_as_source or linked_as_target
