def left_mouse_press(self, event: QtGui.QMouseEvent):
    """Handle left button press.

    Args:
        event (QtGui.QMouseEvent): event.
    """
    item = self.itemAt(event.position().toPoint())
    # A band whose release never came must not hold back the selection.
    if self.interaction_mode is self.InteractionMode.RUBBER_BAND:
        self.set_interaction_mode(self.InteractionMode.NOOP)
    # Store click position for future use
    self.last_lmb_click_pos = self.mapToScene(event.position().toPoint())

    if not item:
        if event.modifiers() & QtCore.Qt.ControlModifier:
            self.set_interaction_mode(self.InteractionMode.LINK_CUT)
            fake_event = QtGui.QMouseEvent(
                QtCore.QEvent.MouseButtonRelease,
                event.position(),
                event.globalPosition(),
                QtCore.Qt.LeftButton,
                QtCore.Qt.NoButton,
                event.modifiers(),
            )
            super().mouseReleaseEvent(fake_event)
            event.ignore()
            return
        else:
            if not self.is_dragging:
                self.gr_stage.selection_model.clearSelection()
            self.set_interaction_mode(self.InteractionMode.RUBBER_BAND)

    super().mousePressEvent(event)

def left_mouse_release(self, event: QtGui.QMouseEvent):
    """Handle left button release, finishing link cutting if active.

    Args:
        event (QtGui.QMouseEvent): event.
    """
    try:
        if self.interaction_mode == self.InteractionMode.LINK_CUT:
            # Back to idle first: undo is off until then and the cut is a command.
            self.set_interaction_mode(self.InteractionMode.NOOP)
            self.cut_intersecting_links()
            self.cutline.clear()
            event.accept()
            return

        if self.interaction_mode is self.InteractionMode.RUBBER_BAND:
            # Qt ends the band and hides its rectangle. The selection is still held
            # back while it does, and synced once the band is over.
            try:
                super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)
            finally:
                self.set_interaction_mode(self.InteractionMode.NOOP)
            self.gr_stage.on_selection_changed()
            return
    except Exception:
        LOGGER.exception("Left mouse release exception")

    super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self, event: QtGui.QMouseEvent) -> None:
    """Enter the scope of a double clicked node.

    Args:
        event (QtGui.QMouseEvent): event.
    """
    gr_item = self.itemAt(event.position().toPoint())
    gr_node = self._owning_gr_node(gr_item) if gr_item else None
    if gr_node is not None:
        self.graph_editor.set_scope_path(gr_node.node.path)
        event.accept()
        return
    if not isinstance(gr_item, GraphicsLinkPin):
        scene_pos = self.mapToScene(event.position().toPoint())
        tolerance = self.LINK_PICK_DISTANCE / max(self.transform().m11(), 1e-6)
        gr_link = self.scene().find_link_at(scene_pos, tolerance)
        if gr_link is not None:
            gr_link.add_pin(scene_pos)
            event.accept()
            return
    if not gr_item:
        event.ignore()
        return
    super().mouseDoubleClickEvent(event)

def paintEvent(self, event: QtGui.QPaintEvent):
    """Paint the scene, then the debug overlay if it is on.

    overlay = self.debug_overlay

def show_context_menu(self, point: QtCore.QPoint):
    """Show the nodes context menu.

    Args:
        point (QtCore.QPoint): position in view coordinates.

    state = self.get_current_state()
    if not state.is_idle:

    ACTION_ROUTER.refresh_enabled()

        self,

        with_util_objects=True,
        has_reference=any(
            gr_node.node.get_source_file() is not None
            for gr_node in self.gr_stage.selected_gr_nodes()
        ),
    )
    context_menus.show_menu(menu, self.mapToGlobal(point))

def step(self, zoom_in: bool) -> float | None:
    """Move the zoom level by one step.

    Args:
        zoom_in (bool): zoom in (True) or out (False).

    Returns:
        float | None: scale factor to apply to the view, None if the step left the
            zoom range and clamping is on. The level is still limited to the
            range then.
    """
    self.zoom += self.zoom_step if zoom_in else -self.zoom_step
    clamped = self.clamp(self.zoom) != self.zoom
    if clamped:
        self.zoom = self.clamp(self.zoom)
    if clamped and self.zoom_clamp:
        return None
    return self.zoom_in_factor if zoom_in else 1.0 / self.zoom_in_factor

def zoom_to_fit(
    self, viewport_size: QtCore.QSize, scene_rect: QtCore.QRectF
) -> float:
    """Get the zoom level that fits a scene rect into a viewport.

    Args:
        viewport_size (QtCore.QSize): size of the viewport.
        scene_rect (QtCore.QRectF): scene rect to fit.

    Returns:
        float: zoom level, limited to the zoom range if clamping is on.
    """
    fit_scale = min(
        viewport_size.width() / scene_rect.width(),
        viewport_size.height() / scene_rect.height(),
    )
    zoom = self.DEFAULT_ZOOM + math.log(fit_scale, self.zoom_in_factor)
    return self.clamp(zoom) if self.zoom_clamp else zoom

def paste_nodes_from_clipboard(self):
    """Paste nodes from the clipboard under the current node."""
    serialized_nodes = clipboard.get_serialized_nodes_from_clipboard()
    if not serialized_nodes:

    parent_node = self.current_node()

        parent_node=parent_node,

def refresh(self) -> None:
    """Show the current state of the server and its clients."""
    server = self._session.bridge_server
    running = server is not None and server.is_running

    self.status_label.setText("Running" if running else "Stopped")
    self.toggle_button.setText("Stop" if running else "Start")
    self.address_label.setText(f"{server.host}:{server.port}" if running else "-")
    self.copy_address_button.setEnabled(running)

    has_token = server is not None
    self.token_edit.setText(server.token if has_token else "-")
    reveal = not has_token or self.show_token_button.isChecked()
    self.token_edit.setEchoMode(
        QtWidgets.QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal
        if reveal
        else QtWidgets.QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password
    )
    self.show_token_button.setEnabled(has_token)
    self.copy_token_button.setEnabled(has_token)

    clients = server.clients if running else []
    self.clients_table.setRowCount(len(clients))
    for row, client in enumerate(clients):
        values = (client.name, client.kind, client.version, client.id)
        for column, value in enumerate(values):
            self.clients_table.setItem(
                row, column, QtWidgets.QTableWidgetItem(str(value))
            )

    """Resize the overlay when the target is resized.

@contextlib.contextmanager
def dimmed_ovelay(widget: QtWidgets.QWidget, opacity: int = 140):
    """Dim a widget within a context.

    Args:
        widget (QtWidgets.QWidget): widget to dim.
        opacity (int): overlay alpha, 0-255.

    Yields:
        None: while the overlay is shown.
    """
    overlay = DimOverlay(target=widget, opacity=opacity)
    overlay.show()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        overlay.hide()
        overlay.deleteLater()

def update_data(self):
    """Show the selected node of the active editor, or the root node."""
    if self.current_stage_graph is None:
        self.clear()
        self.setEnabled(False)
        return

    self.setEnabled(True)
    selected_nodes = self.current_stage_graph.list_selected_nodes()
    node = (
        selected_nodes[0]
        if selected_nodes
        else self.current_stage_graph.stage.root_node
    )
    LOGGER.debug(f"Updating inspector: {node.path}")
    self._node_header.set_node(node_uuid=node.uuid if node else None)
    self._error_banner.set_node(node)
    self._watch_model(node.model() if node else None)
    self._node_components_view.setModel(node.components_model)

def refresh(self) -> None:
    """Show the current error of the node, or hide the block if it has none."""
    error = None
    if self._node is not None:
        if self._node.execution_status is NodeExecutionStatus.ERROR:
            error = self._node.raised_exception
    self._error = error
    if error is None:
        self._summary = ""
        self.setVisible(False)
        return
    message = str(error).strip()
    self._summary = (
        f"{type(error).__name__}: {message}" if message else type(error).__name__
    )
    single_line = " ".join(self._summary.split())
    self._label.setToolTip(self._summary)
    self._label.setText(single_line)
    self._elide()
    self.setVisible(True)

@classmethod
def add_message(
    cls,
    text: str,
    fade: float | None = None,
    icon: str | QtGui.QIcon | None = None,
) -> NotificationMessage | None:
    """Show a message.

    Args:
        text (str): message text.
        fade (float | None): seconds until it fades out, None or 0 to keep it
            until it is dismissed.
        icon (str | QIcon | None): icon or resource path of one.

    Returns:
        NotificationMessage | None: the message, None if it can't be shown right
            now: there is no window, or this is not the GUI thread, then it is
            shown as soon as that thread gets to it.
    """
    manager = cls._instance
    if manager is None:
        return None
    if QtCore.QThread.currentThread() is not manager.thread():
        manager._requested.emit(text, float(fade or 0), icon)
        return None
    return manager._add_message(text, fade, icon)

    self,
    text: str,

    """Initialize NotificationMessage.

    self.setObjectName("NotificationMessage")
    self.setStyleSheet(
        "#NotificationMessage { background-color: #2b2b2b; border: 1px solid #555;"
        " border-radius: 8px; } #NotificationMessage QLabel { color: #eeeeee; }"
    )

    self.setGraphicsEffect(self._opacity_effect)

    layout = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(self)
    layout.setContentsMargins(16, 14, 10, 14)
    layout.setSpacing(12)
    self._icon_label = QtWidgets.QLabel(self)
    qicon = QtGui.QIcon(icon) if isinstance(icon, str) else icon
    if qicon is not None and not qicon.isNull():
        self._icon_label.setPixmap(qicon.pixmap(self.ICON_SIZE, self.ICON_SIZE))
        layout.addWidget(
            self._icon_label, alignment=QtCore.Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        )

    self._text_label.setWordWrap(True)

    self.dismiss_button = QtWidgets.QToolButton(self)
    self.dismiss_button.setText("✕")
    self.dismiss_button.setAutoRaise(True)
    self.dismiss_button.setToolTip("Dismiss")
    self.dismiss_button.setFixedSize(24, 24)
    self.dismiss_button.setStyleSheet(
        "QToolButton { color: #aaaaaa; border: none; font-size: 14px; }"
        "QToolButton:hover { color: #ffffff; }"
    )
    self.dismiss_button.clicked.connect(self.dismiss)
    layout.addWidget(self.dismiss_button, alignment=QtCore.Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)

    self._animation = QtCore.QPropertyAnimation(
        self._opacity_effect, b"opacity", self
    )
    self._on_animation_finished: typing.Callable[[], None] | None = None
    self._animation.finished.connect(self._handle_animation_finished)
    self._fade_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
    self._fade_timer.setSingleShot(True)
    self._fade_timer.timeout.connect(self.dismiss)
    if fade and fade > 0:

    self.setMinimumWidth(self.MIN_WIDTH)
    self.adjustSize()

def filter_nodes_by_scope(self, nodes: list[Node]) -> list[Node]:
    """Filter nodes by scope.

    Args:
        nodes (list[Node]): Nodes to filter.

    Returns:
        list[Node]: Filtered nodes.

    """
    current_scope_node = self.stage.get_object(self.get_scope_path())
    scope_child_nodes = self.stage.list_children(current_scope_node)
    filtered_nodes = list(set(nodes).intersection(set(scope_child_nodes)))
    return filtered_nodes

def get_next_valid_scope(self, scope: NodeLike):
    """Find the closest existing scope, walking up the parents.

    Args:
        scope (NodeLike): wanted scope.

    Returns:
        pathlib.PurePosixPath | None: closest existing path.
    """
    scope_path = self.stage.pathify(scope)
    paths_to_check = [scope_path]
    paths_to_check.extend(scope_path.parents)
    for each_path in paths_to_check:
        try:
            self.stage.get_object(each_path)
            return each_path
        except StageObjectQueryError:
            continue

def maybe_save(self) -> bool:
    """Prompt user to save current scene it is new or has been modified.

    Returns:
        bool: True if user saved the scene or chose discard option.

    """
    if self.stage.is_new() or not self.stage.is_modified():
        return True

    stage_title = (
        self.DEFAULT_TITLE if not self.stage.file_path else self.stage.file_path.name
    )
    res = QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(
        self,
        "Stage is not saved",
        f'Save changes to "{stage_title}"?',
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Save
        | QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Discard
        | QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Cancel,
    )
    if res == QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Save:
        return self.on_stage_save()
    if res == QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Cancel:
        return False
    return True

def set_stage(self, stage: Stage | None, create_connections=True):
    """Replace the edited stage and register it with the session.

    Args:
        stage (Stage | None): new stage. A new one is created if None.
        create_connections (bool): connect the stage signals.
    """
    old_stage = self.stage
    if stage is None:
        stage = Stage()
    stage.undo_limit = get_app_config().values.editor_behaviour.undo_limit
    session = self.main_window.application.session
    if old_stage:
        session.unregister_stage(old_stage)
    session.register_stage(stage)
    self._stage = stage
    self._selection_model.setModel(stage)
    self.stage_changed.emit(stage)
    if create_connections:
        self.create_stage_connections()
    if old_stage:
        old_stage.deleteLater()

def drawContents(self, painter: QtGui.QPainter) -> None:
    """Draw the message at the left of the footer, elided to leave the version.

    Args:
        painter (QtGui.QPainter): painter of the splash.
    """
    font = self._font(self.FOOTER_PIXEL_SIZE)
    metrics = QtGui.QFontMetrics(font)
    available_width = (
        self.FOOTER_RECT.width()
        - metrics.horizontalAdvance(self.VERSION_TEXT)
        - self.FOOTER_GAP
    )
    painter.setFont(font)
    painter.setPen(self.SECONDARY_COLOR)
    painter.drawText(
        self.FOOTER_RECT,
        QtCore.Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | QtCore.Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter,
        metrics.elidedText(
            self.message(), QtCore.Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, available_width
        ),
    )

def event(self, event: QtCore.QEvent) -> bool:
    """Handle events without `QSplashScreen.event`.

    `QSplashScreen.event` makes the show event block for a second on macOS,
    before the first message can be shown. Skipping it, the splash paints its
    pixmap and contents itself, and the rest is handled by `QWidget`.

    Args:
        event (QtCore.QEvent): event.

    Returns:
        bool: event was handled.
    """
    if event.type() != QtCore.QEvent.Type.Paint:
        return QtWidgets.QWidget.event(self, event)
    painter = QtGui.QPainter(self)
    painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, self.pixmap())
    self.drawContents(painter)
    return True

@contextlib.contextmanager
def watching(self) -> typing.Iterator[ExecutionProgressDialog]:
    """Context in which the dialog follows the log and shows up if it takes long."""
    handler = logging_fn.add_signal_handler(logging.getLogger())
    handler.emitter.record_logged.connect(self.on_record_logged)
    self._show_timer.start()
    try:
        yield self
    finally:
        self._show_timer.stop()
        handler.emitter.record_logged.disconnect(self.on_record_logged)
        self.hide()

@staticmethod
def clamp_to_bounds(
    top_left: QtCore.QPoint, size: QtCore.QSize, bounds: QtCore.QRect
) -> QtCore.QPoint:
    """Move a rectangle inside bounds, keeping its top left corner visible.

    Args:
        top_left (QtCore.QPoint): wanted top left corner.
        size (QtCore.QSize): size of the rectangle.
        bounds (QtCore.QRect): area the rectangle has to stay in.

    Returns:
        QtCore.QPoint: top left corner that keeps the rectangle in bounds. A
            rectangle bigger than the bounds is aligned to their top left.
    """
    x = min(top_left.x(), bounds.right() - size.width() + 1)
    y = min(top_left.y(), bounds.bottom() - size.height() + 1)

def move_within_screen(
    self, top_left: QtCore.QPoint, anchor: QtCore.QPoint | None = None
):
    """Move the palette so it is fully inside the usable area of a screen.

    Args:
        top_left (QtCore.QPoint): wanted global top left corner.
        anchor (QtCore.QPoint | None): global point choosing the screen, such as
            the cursor. Defaults to the top left corner.
    """
    screen = (
        QtGui.QGuiApplication.screenAt(anchor or top_left)
        or QtGui.QGuiApplication.primaryScreen()
    )
    if screen is None:
        self.move(top_left)
        return
    self.move(
        self.clamp_to_bounds(top_left, self.size(), screen.availableGeometry())
    )

@classmethod
def popup(cls, on_node_spawned: typing.Callable[[Node], None] | None = None):
    """Show the palette at the cursor, creating nodes at that scene position.

    Args:
        on_node_spawned (Callable[[Node], None] | None): called with the node
            created by the palette.
    """
    current_editor = cls.get_current_editor()
    if current_editor is None:
        return

    stage_graph_view = current_editor.gr_view

    global_pos = QtGui.QCursor.pos()
    scene_pos = stage_graph_view.mapToScene(
        stage_graph_view.mapFromGlobal(global_pos)
    )

    palette = cls(scene_pos, parent=stage_graph_view.window())
    palette.set_spawner_position(QtCore.QPointF(scene_pos.x(), scene_pos.y()))
    if on_node_spawned is not None:
        palette._nodes_palette_view.nodes_spawner.nodeSpawned.connect(
            on_node_spawned
        )
    palette.move_within_screen(global_pos)
    palette.exec()
    return palette

    current_editor = cls.get_current_editor()

def data(self, index, role=Qt.DisplayRole):
    """Get the role id, name or current value for a cell.

    Args:
        index (QModelIndex): cell index.
        role (int): data role.

    Returns:
        Cell text or value, None for unsupported roles.
    """
    if not index.isValid() or role != Qt.DisplayRole:
        return None
    role_id, role_name = self._roles[index.row()]
    col = index.column()
    if col == 0:
        return role_id
    if col == 1:
        return role_name
    if col == 2:
        if not self._index.isValid():
            return None
        value = self._index.data(role_id)  # goes through your data()
        return (
            "<invalid>"
            if value is None
            else repr(value)
            if not isinstance(value, str)
            else value
        )
    return None

def __init__(
    self,
    stage: Stage,
    target_types: tuple[type, ...] = (Node, NodeComponent),
    current_target: Node | NodeComponent | None = None,
    parent: QtWidgets.QWidget | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Initialize StageObjectPickerDialog.

    Args:
        stage (Stage): stage to choose from.
        target_types (tuple[type, ...]): what can be chosen, `Node` and
            `NodeComponent`. Components are not listed when it has no
            `NodeComponent`.
        current_target (Node | NodeComponent | None): object to start at.
        parent (QtWidgets.QWidget | None): parent widget.
    """
    super().__init__(parent)
    self.setWindowTitle("Select stage object")
    self.resize(640, 480)
    self._stage = stage
    self._target_types = target_types
    self._items: dict[UUID, QtWidgets.QTreeWidgetItem] = {}

    self.search_field = QtWidgets.QLineEdit(self)
    self.search_field.setPlaceholderText("Search")
    self.search_field.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
    self.tree = QtWidgets.QTreeWidget(self)
    self.tree.setColumnCount(len(self.COLUMNS))
    self.tree.setHeaderLabels(list(self.COLUMNS))
    self.tree.setUniformRowHeights(True)
    self.tree.setSelectionMode(
        QtWidgets.QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection
    )
    self.buttons = QtWidgets.QDialogButtonBox(
        QtWidgets.QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok
        | QtWidgets.QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel,
        self,
    )

    layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
    layout.addWidget(self.search_field)
    layout.addWidget(self.tree)
    layout.addWidget(self.buttons)

    self._fill_tree()
    self.search_field.textChanged.connect(self._apply_filter)
    self.tree.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_ok_button)
    self.tree.itemDoubleClicked.connect(self._on_item_double_clicked)
    self.buttons.accepted.connect(self.accept)
    self.buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)

    self._select(current_target)
    self._update_ok_button()
    self.search_field.setFocus()

@classmethod
def pick(
    cls,
    stage: Stage,
    component: NodeComponent,
    parent: QtWidgets.QWidget | None = None,
) -> Node | NodeComponent | None:
    """Ask the user for the object a path component should point at.

    Args:
        stage (Stage): stage to choose from.
        component (NodeComponent): path component being filled, tells what may be
            chosen (`target_types`) and where to start (`target`).
        parent (QtWidgets.QWidget | None): parent widget.

    Returns:
        Node | NodeComponent | None: chosen object, None if the dialog was
            cancelled.
    """
    dialog = cls(
        stage,
        target_types=getattr(component, "target_types", (Node, NodeComponent)),
        current_target=getattr(component, "target", None),
        parent=parent,
    )
    if dialog.exec() == QtWidgets.QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
        return dialog.selected_object
    return None

    """Refill the recent files submenu from the session."""
    self.recent_menu.clear()

def rebuild_editors(self):
    """List every open editor window, checking the active one."""
    for editor_action in self._editor_actions:
        self.removeAction(editor_action)
        self._editors_group.removeAction(editor_action)
        editor_action.deleteLater()
    self._editor_actions.clear()

    mdi_area = self.main_window.mdi_area
    active = mdi_area.currentSubWindow()
    for sub_window in mdi_area.subWindowList():
        editor_action = self.addAction(sub_window.windowTitle())
        editor_action.setCheckable(True)
        editor_action.setChecked(sub_window is active)
        stage_file = sub_window.widget().stage.file_path
        if stage_file:
            editor_action.setToolTip(str(stage_file))
        editor_action.triggered.connect(
            functools.partial(self._activate_editor, sub_window)
        )
        self._editors_group.addAction(editor_action)
        self._editor_actions.append(editor_action)

    if not self._editor_actions:
        placeholder = self.addAction("(No open editors)")
        placeholder.setEnabled(False)
        self._editor_actions.append(placeholder)

def rebuild_recent_menu(self):
    """Refill the recent files submenu from the session."""
    self.recent_menu.clear()
    recent_files = self.main_window.config.values.editor_session.recent_files
    if not recent_files:
        placeholder = self.recent_menu.addAction("(No recent files)")
        placeholder.setEnabled(False)
        return

    for file_path in list(recent_files):
        recent_action = self.recent_menu.addAction(pathlib.Path(file_path).name)
        recent_action.setToolTip(file_path)
        recent_action.setStatusTip(file_path)
        recent_action.triggered.connect(
            functools.partial(self._open_recent, file_path)
        )

Source code in src/nyx/editor/widgets/menubar_menus/session_menu.py 
def rebuild_editors(self):
    """List every open editor window, checking the active one."""
    for editor_action in self._editor_actions:
        self.removeAction(editor_action)
        self._editors_group.removeAction(editor_action)
        editor_action.deleteLater()
    self._editor_actions.clear()

    mdi_area = self.main_window.mdi_area
    active = mdi_area.currentSubWindow()
    for sub_window in mdi_area.subWindowList():
        editor_action = self.addAction(sub_window.windowTitle())
        editor_action.setCheckable(True)
        editor_action.setChecked(sub_window is active)
        stage_file = sub_window.widget().stage.file_path
        if stage_file:
            editor_action.setToolTip(str(stage_file))
        editor_action.triggered.connect(
            functools.partial(self._activate_editor, sub_window)
        )
        self._editors_group.addAction(editor_action)
        self._editor_actions.append(editor_action)

    if not self._editor_actions:
        placeholder = self.addAction("(No open editors)")
        placeholder.setEnabled(False)
        self._editor_actions.append(placeholder)

def paint(
    self,
    painter: QtGui.QPainter,
    option: QtWidgets.QStyleOptionViewItem,
    index: QtCore.QModelIndex | QtCore.QPersistentModelIndex,
) -> None:
    """Draw the log record row.

    Args:
        painter (QtGui.QPainter): painter.
        option (QtWidgets.QStyleOptionViewItem): style options.
        index (QtCore.QModelIndex | QtCore.QPersistentModelIndex): item index.
    """
    painter.save()

    is_row_selected = bool(option.state & QtWidgets.QStyle.StateFlag.State_Selected)
    if is_row_selected:
        painter.fillRect(option.rect, option.palette.highlight())
    text_color = (
        option.palette.highlightedText().color()
        if is_row_selected
        else option.palette.text().color()
    )

    log_record: logging.LogRecord = index.data(LogRecordListModel.LogRecordRole)
    severity_color = color_for_logging_level(log_record.levelno)
    timestamp_text = logging_fn.format_log_record_timestamp(log_record)
    level_name_text = log_record.levelname
    message_text = logging_fn.format_log_record_message_as_single_line(log_record)

    font_metrics: QtGui.QFontMetrics = option.fontMetrics
    row_rect: QtCore.QRect = option.rect

    # Coloured severity bar
    severity_bar_rect = QtCore.QRect(
        row_rect.left() + self.HORIZONTAL_MARGIN_IN_PIXELS,
        row_rect.top() + 2,
        self.SEVERITY_BAR_WIDTH_IN_PIXELS,
        row_rect.height() - 4,
    )
    painter.fillRect(severity_bar_rect, severity_color)

    current_x_position = (
        severity_bar_rect.right() + self.HORIZONTAL_SPACING_IN_PIXELS
    )

    # Timestamp
    timestamp_width_in_pixels = font_metrics.horizontalAdvance("00:00:00")
    timestamp_rect = QtCore.QRect(
        current_x_position,
        row_rect.top(),
        timestamp_width_in_pixels,
        row_rect.height(),
    )
    painter.setPen(text_color)
    painter.setOpacity(0.6)
    painter.drawText(
        timestamp_rect,
        QtCore.Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter | QtCore.Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft,
        timestamp_text,
    )
    painter.setOpacity(1.0)
    current_x_position = timestamp_rect.right() + self.HORIZONTAL_SPACING_IN_PIXELS

    # Level name (bold; measured with the bold font, elided for odd custom names)
    bold_font = painter.font()
    bold_font.setBold(True)
    painter.setFont(bold_font)
    bold_font_metrics = QtGui.QFontMetrics(bold_font)
    level_name_width_in_pixels = max(
        bold_font_metrics.horizontalAdvance(expected_level_name_text)
        for expected_level_name_text in self.EXPECTED_LEVEL_NAME_TEXTS
    )
    level_name_rect = QtCore.QRect(
        current_x_position,
        row_rect.top(),
        level_name_width_in_pixels,
        row_rect.height(),
    )
    painter.setPen(severity_color if not is_row_selected else text_color)
    painter.drawText(
        level_name_rect,
        QtCore.Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter | QtCore.Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft,
        bold_font_metrics.elidedText(
            level_name_text,
            QtCore.Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight,
            level_name_rect.width(),
        ),
    )
    bold_font.setBold(False)
    painter.setFont(bold_font)
    current_x_position = level_name_rect.right() + self.HORIZONTAL_SPACING_IN_PIXELS

    # Message (elided; full text is available as the tooltip)
    message_rect = QtCore.QRect(
        current_x_position,
        row_rect.top(),
        max(
            0,
            row_rect.right() - self.HORIZONTAL_MARGIN_IN_PIXELS - current_x_position,
        ),
        row_rect.height(),
    )
    elided_message_text = font_metrics.elidedText(
        message_text, QtCore.Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, message_rect.width()
    )

def filterAcceptsRow(
    self, source_row: int, source_parent: QModelIndex | QPersistentModelIndex
) -> bool:
    """bool: record passes the level and text filters."""
    source_index = self.sourceModel().index(source_row, 0, source_parent)
    record: logging.LogRecord | None = source_index.data(
        LogRecordListModel.LogRecordRole
    )
    if record is None:
        return False
    if record.levelno < self._minimum_level:
        return False
    if not self._search_text:
        return True
    return (
        self._search_text in record.getMessage().casefold()
        or self._search_text in record.name.casefold()
    )

def apply_config_values(self, config: NyxConfig) -> None:
    """Apply stored values.

def resizeEvent(self, resize_event: QtGui.QResizeEvent) -> None:
    """Remember the height the user resized the expanded dock to.

    Args:
        resize_event (QtGui.QResizeEvent): event.
    """
    super().resizeEvent(resize_event)

    if not self.output_log_widget.is_expanded():
        return

    # Ignore startup layout passes and our own programmatic resizes.
    if (
        not self.isVisible()
        or self._is_restore_of_expanded_height_pending
        or self._is_restoring_expanded_height_programmatically
    ):
        return

    # Remember the height only while expanded, ignoring transitional
    # sizes below the expanded minimum.
    current_height_in_pixels = self.height()
    if current_height_in_pixels >= self._minimum_expanded_height_in_pixels():
        self._last_user_expanded_height = current_height_in_pixels

docs.text:
Resize the dock to the last user height if it is expanded and visible.

Source code in src/nyx/editor/widgets/output_log/output_log_dock.py 
def restore_expanded_height_into_main_window_if_possible(self) -> None:
    """Resize the dock to the last user height if it is expanded and visible."""
    if not self.output_log_widget.is_expanded():
        return

    parent_main_window = self.parentWidget()
    if not isinstance(parent_main_window, QtWidgets.QMainWindow):
        return

    if not self.isVisible():
        # Hidden docks are not part of the main window layout, so
        # resizeDocks would be a no-op. visibilityChanged calls us again
        # when the dock is shown.
        return

    self._is_restoring_expanded_height_programmatically = True
    parent_main_window.resizeDocks(
        [self],
        [self._last_user_expanded_height],
        QtCore.Qt.Orientation.Vertical,
    )
    # Qt applies the new layout on a later event-loop turn, so keep
    # ignoring resize events until then. Otherwise intermediate sizes
    # would overwrite the remembered height.
    QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self._finish_programmatic_restore_of_expanded_height)

def __init__(
    self,
    forward: dict[KT, VT] | None = None,
    _backward: dict[VT, KT] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Initialize InvertibleDict.

    Args:
        forward (dict[KT, VT] | None): initial items.
        _backward (dict[VT, KT] | None): prebuilt inverse mapping, used to
            create the inverse view.

    Raises:
        ValueError: if two keys map to the same value.
    """
    if forward is None:
        self._forward = {}
        self._backward = {}
    elif _backward is not None:
        self._forward = forward
        self._backward = _backward
    else:
        self._forward = forward
        self._backward = {value: key for key, value in self._forward.items()}
        self._check_non_invertible()

def __setitem__(self, key: KT, value: VT) -> None:
    """Set a key, keeping the inverse mapping in sync.

    Args:
        key (KT): key.
        value (VT): value.

    Raises:
        ValueError: if another key already maps to the value.
    """
    missing = object()
    old_key = self._backward.get(value, missing)
    if old_key is not missing and old_key != key:
        self._raise_non_invertible(old_key, key, value)

    old_value = self._forward.get(key, missing)
    if old_value is not missing:
        del self._backward[old_value]

    self._forward[key] = value
    self._backward[value] = key

def pad_for_macos(image: QtGui.QImage, size: int | None = None) -> QtGui.QImage:
    """Shrink the artwork to the macOS ratio, centered on a transparent canvas.

    Args:
        image (QtGui.QImage): square full-bleed icon image.
        size (int | None): pixel size of the result, the image size by default.

    Returns:
        QtGui.QImage: square image with a transparent margin.
    """
    size = size or image.width()
    art_size = round(size * MACOS_ART_RATIO)
    art = image.scaled(
        art_size,
        art_size,
        QtCore.Qt.AspectRatioMode.IgnoreAspectRatio,
        QtCore.Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation,
    )
    canvas = QtGui.QImage(size, size, QtGui.QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)
    canvas.fill(QtCore.Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
    painter = QtGui.QPainter(canvas)
    painter.drawImage((size - art_size) // 2, (size - art_size) // 2, art)
    painter.end()
    return canvas

def load_json(
    path: pathlib.Path | str | None = None,
    input_str: str | None = None,
    object_pairs_hook=None,
) -> dict:
    """Load json data from file or string.

    Args:
        path (pathlib.Path | str, optional): path to json file. Defaults to None.
        input_str (str, optional): json string. Defaults to None.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If no file path or string were provided.

    Returns:
        dict: loaded json data.

    """
    if path is None and input_str is None:
        raise ValueError("Invalid parameters: neither path or json string were given.")

    if input_str:
        data = json.loads(input_str)
    else:
        path = pathlib.Path(path) if not isinstance(path, pathlib.Path) else path
        with path.open("r") as json_file:
            data = json.load(json_file, object_pairs_hook=object_pairs_hook)
    return data

    path: pathlib.Path | str,
    data: dict,
    as_string: bool = False,
    sort_keys: bool = True,
    indent: int = 4,
) -> pathlib.Path:
    """Write json file.

    Args:
        path (pathlib.Path | str): path to json file.
        data (dict): data to write.
        as_string (bool, optional): write data as json string. Defaults to False.
        sort_keys (bool, optional): sort data keys. Defaults to True.
        indent (int, optional): indentation inside written file. Defaults to 4.

    Returns:
        pathlib.Path: path to written file.

    """
    if not isinstance(path, pathlib.Path):
        path = pathlib.Path(path)

    with path.open("w") as json_file:
        if as_string:
            json_file.write(
                json.dumps(data, sort_keys=sort_keys, indent=4, separators=(",", ":"))
            )
        else:
            json.dump(data, json_file, indent=indent)
    return path

def add_signal_handler(
    logger: logging.Logger,
    formatter: LogFormat | logging.Formatter = LogFormat.minimal,
) -> QSignalHandler:
    """Attach a signal handler to a logger, once.

    Args:
        logger (logging.Logger): logger to attach to.
        formatter (LogFormat | logging.Formatter): message formatter.

    Returns:
        QSignalHandler: handler attached to the logger.
    """
    if hasattr(logger, "signal_handler"):
        return logger.signal_handler

    if isinstance(formatter, LogFormat):
        formatter = logging.Formatter(formatter.value)

    signal_handler = QSignalHandler()
    signal_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
    logger.addHandler(signal_handler)
    logger.signal_handler = signal_handler
    return signal_handler

docs.title: profiling
docs.text:
Drop-in module combining
  • codetiming.Timer -> lightweight, always-on per-call timing (cheap, safe for prod)
  • cProfile/pstats -> deterministic call profiling, gated behind NYX_PROFILING env var
Usage

from nyx.utils.profiling import profile

@profile() # writes my_function_profile.pstats when NYX_PROFILING=1 def my_function(): ...

Env vars

NYX_PROFILING -> "1"/"true"/"yes" to enable profiling (default: off)

docs.title: profile(name=None, text='{name}: {seconds:.4f}s')
docs.text:
Always logs timing; additionally dumps a pstats file under PROFILING_DIR.

Source code in src/nyx/utils/profiling.py 
def profile(name=None, text="{name}: {seconds:.4f}s"):
    """Always logs timing; additionally dumps a pstats file under PROFILING_DIR."""

    def decorator(func):
        """Wrap a function with timing and optional profiling.

        Args:
            func: function to wrap.

        Returns:
            The wrapped function.
        """
        timer_name = name or func.__name__

        @wraps(func)
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            """Time the call and write a profile when profiling is enabled."""
            with Timer(name=timer_name, text=text, logger=LOGGER.info):
                if not PROFILING:
                    return func(*args, **kwargs)

                PROFILING_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                # Skip if a profiler is already running in this thread (nested call)
                if getattr(_LOCAL_THREAD, "active", False):
                    return func(*args, **kwargs)

                profiler = cProfile.Profile()
                _LOCAL_THREAD.active = True
                try:
                    result = profiler.runcall(func, *args, **kwargs)
                finally:
                    _LOCAL_THREAD.active = False

                path = PROFILING_DIR / f"{func.__name__}_profile.pstats"
                profiler.dump_stats(path)
                LOGGER.info('snakeviz "%s"', path)

                return result

        return wrapper

    return decorator

def min_bounding_rect(rects: list[QtCore.QRect]):
    """Get the rectangle containing all given rectangles.

    Args:
        rects (list[QtCore.QRect]): rectangles, at least one.

    Returns:
        QtCore.QRectF: bounding rectangle.
    """
    min_x = rects[0].left()
    min_y = rects[0].top()
    max_x = rects[0].right()
    max_y = rects[0].bottom()

    for k in range(1, len(rects)):
        min_x = min(min_x, rects[k].left())
        min_y = min(min_y, rects[k].top())
        max_x = max(max_x, rects[k].right())
        max_y = max(max_y, rects[k].bottom())

    return QtCore.QRectF(min_x, min_y, max_x - min_x, max_y - min_y)

def screen_for_window_geometry(
    position: tuple[int, int] | None, size: tuple[int, int] | None
) -> QtGui.QScreen:
    """Find the screen a window with the given geometry opens on.

    Args:
        position (tuple[int, int] | None): window position, None for the default.
        size (tuple[int, int] | None): window size, None for the default.

    Returns:
        QtGui.QScreen: screen holding the window center, the primary screen if the
            geometry is not set or lies outside every screen.
    """
    primary_screen = QtGui.QGuiApplication.primaryScreen()
    if not position or not size:
        return primary_screen
    window_rect = QtCore.QRect(QtCore.QPoint(*position), QtCore.QSize(*size))
    return QtGui.QGuiApplication.screenAt(window_rect.center()) or primary_screen

docs.title: __call__(*args, **kwargs)
docs.text:
Possible changes to the value of the __init__ argument do not affect the returned instance.

Source code in src/nyx/utils/singleton.py 
def __call__(cls, *args, **kwargs):
    """
    Possible changes to the value of the `__init__` argument do not affect
    the returned instance.
    """
    # Now, imagine that the program has just been launched. Since there's no
    # Singleton instance yet, multiple threads can simultaneously pass the
    # previous conditional and reach this point almost at the same time. The
    # first of them will acquire lock and will proceed further, while the
    # rest will wait here.
    with cls._lock:
        # The first thread to acquire the lock, reaches this conditional,
        # goes inside and creates the Singleton instance. Once it leaves the
        # lock block, a thread that might have been waiting for the lock
        # release may then enter this section. But since the Singleton field
        # is already initialized, the thread won't create a new object.
        if cls not in cls._instances:
            instance = super().__call__(*args, **kwargs)
            cls._instances[cls] = instance
    return cls._instances[cls]

docs.title: Developer Guide
docs.text: This guide is for people who extend Nyx with plugins or work on Nyx itself.

docs.title: Pages

Profiling Timing and call profiling with NYX_PROFILING. Writing plugins The anatomy of a plugin, and pages for each kind of content: node, function node, component, QML for a component, datatype, util object, graphics object. API reference Generated from the docstrings of nyx.core, nyx.editor and the rest of the package (see the navigation).

docs.title: Architecture in one page
docs.text:
nyx
├── core         Qt backend, no widgets
│   ├── Stage                owns the undo stack, the node tree and the crawler
│   ├── Node / NodeComponent QStandardItems; components are connected by Links
│   ├── UtilObject           notes and groups
│   ├── commands/            every change is a QUndoCommand (NyxCommand)
│   ├── StageCrawler         executes a stage; ExecutionChain says which nodes the flow reaches
│   ├── plugin_subsystem/    loader, manager and the registry
│   └── session.py           NyxSession: config, open stages, bridge server
├── api.v1       the public API: plugins import from here
├── stdlib       the core plugin: nodes, components, notes, groups
├── plugins      built-in function node plugins
├── editor       widgets, the graphics scene, views and QML UI
├── cli.py       nyx, nyx stage run, nyx-run-stage
└── static       enums, variables and the paths of user files

Points to keep in mind when working on the code:

  • Everything that changes a stage is a command. Commands derive from NyxCommand (core/commands/), hold the stage weakly, say which nodes they touch (target_nodes, so nodes of a reference can be protected) and set MODIFIES_STRUCTURE when they add, remove or redefine nodes or components. Use them from plugins and tools too: stage.push_command(command).
  • Stages are held weakly. Keep a reference to a Stage you create, or its nodes and commands lose it.
  • nyx.api.v1 is the contract. Add to it when a plugin needs something new, don't let plugins reach into nyx.core.
  • Application startup is NyxApplication.__init__: register built-in content, pre_initialize(), load plugins, post_initialize(). Subclasses override the hooks (NyxEditorApplication shows the splash screen in pre_initialize and builds the QML engine and main window in post_initialize) rather than reordering around super().__init__. Prefer adding a no-op pre_*/post_* hook to a base class over changing its constructor.
  • Paths of user files are all defined in nyx/static/paths.py.

docs.title: Working on Nyx
docs.text:
uv sync --locked --dev       # install
make check                   # ruff + tests
make pytest                  # tests only: uv run pytest tests
make lint-fix                # ruff autofix (line length 89, rules E, F, UP)
make qrc                     # regenerate resources_rc.py after editing .qrc files or icons
make mkdocs                  # this documentation, with live reload

Tests use QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen. Tests of the editor start the editor application with pytest-qt, and the with_plugins(*plugin_ids) marker initializes plugins for a test. Coverage is always on; the output_dir fixture writes under test_output/.

Code conventions: Google-style docstrings (Args:, Returns:, Raises:), new widgets create their parts in _create_actions, _create_widgets, _create_layouts and _create_connections, all run from __init__. develop is the default and PR branch.
